Iron Flame.full_text: Cam lies to his father, who believes that his son is on a tour across the whole kingdom to celebrate his twentieth birthday. Instead, Cam joins Basgiath, where he seesViolet Sorrengail, who instantly recognizes him as they were childhood friends.When she confronts him, he lies by calling himself Aaric Graycastle in order to hide his true identity. After successfully crossingthe parapethe becomes a first year cadet. He is quickly determined to be a good fighter, though his Assessment Day match againstSloane, who is not a trained fighter, was not a fair match.Aaric's true identity as the king's son is the first secret Violet shares withRhiannon. It is noted that Aaric stands in front of Violet on Conscription Day after the first-years are sorted into formation, which suggests that he is in Flame Section, Fourth Wing. DuringThreshing, he manages to bond to a Blue Clubtail. When Violet first sees the Blue Dragon it is described as:Wingbeats fill the air again, and we all look to the right as a Blue Clubtail approaches with sapphire-hued scales that contrast the changing colors of the sunset sky, and he is beautiful.When Aaric arrives in the field on Molvic, he dismounts from the Blue Clubtail like hes been doing it for years, with an ease that reminds Violet of Xaden and Liam. Later on, Violet meets up with Cam and pulls him through thewardsin her room, where she asks him for his help, as they need him to be able to accessthe Archives' vault due to his royal heritage. Cam refuses to help, especially after he facesXaden, who isn't sorry for killing his brotherAlic, describing him as a craven, murderous prick. However, they finally convince Cam to join them after explaining that he will be stealing from his father, who Cam despises more than he despises Xaden, if he were to help them out. They successfully make it to the vault, where he has to hold Violet's hand to push her through the archway that is sealed bymagicto stop anyone from directly entering. They retrieve thejournalsofWarrickandLyraand making it out in time before the gates close. His hands are badly blistered by the wards, but he is not found to be an accomplice thanks to medicine. He is present in the Wardstone chamber in Basgiath when Violet, and then GeneralSorrengail, are imbuing the wardstone with power. General Sorrengail recognizes him, and mentions his father is looking for him. He protests that he is a bonded rider, and she brushes him off to continue to the wardstone.When General Sorrengail begins using Sloane to imbue the wardstone, Aaric pulls Violet off of the stone. She fights him, but is too weakened to resist. He apologizes to her, but doesn't release her until Lilith Sorrengail is done sacrificing herself.

Later on, Violet meets up with Cam and pulls him through thewardsin her room, where she asks him for his help, as they need him to be able to accessthe Archives' vault due to his royal heritage.
Cam refuses to help, especially after he facesXaden, who isn't sorry for killing his brotherAlic, describing him as a craven, murderous prick.
However, they finally convince Cam to join them after explaining that he will be stealing from his father, who Cam despises more than he despises Xaden, if he were to help them out.

She fights him, but is too weakened to resist.
He apologizes to her, but doesn't release her until Lilith Sorrengail is done sacrificing herself.

paragraphs: Asher Sorrengail(ne Daxton) was ascribeand husband ofLilith Sorrengail.He is the father toBrennan,MiraandViolet.

Biography.full_text: Asher entered the Scribe Quadrant at his conscription. After graduating, he climbed the ranks to Second Lieutenant. At this stage in his life, he travelled toUnnbrieland wroteUnnbriel: The Isle ofDunne. After marrying Lilith Sorrengail, he and her have three children, Brennan Sorrengail, Mira Sorrengail, and Violet Sorrengail. In615 AU, Asher left Mira and Brennan with his mother,Niara, while him, Lilith, and Violet went away for a summer. During this summer, Asher takes Violet to Unnbrish without Lilith and has their priestess partially dedicate Violet to Dunne. However, an oracle said that Violet had multiple paths and could not be completely dedicated. When they returned, Niara stopped speaking to them.Violet was a two-year-old and this was the time her hair started to grow in. Lilith and Asher cut off communication with Niara. She knew he was studying in the Isles. After reaching the rank of Captain, Asher visited Hedotis and wrote,Hedotis: Isle of Hedon.After reaching the rank of Major, he travelled to Zehyllna and wrote,Zehyllna: Isle of Zihnal. He began working as a scribe inthe Archiveswhen Lilith was stationed atBasgiath War Collegeas an instructor. He raised his daughter, Violet, in the library.He tried to prepare Violet and Dain for the future he predicted before his death. He considered his eldest children joining theRiders Quadranta failure of his. He began aresearch projectabout the secondKrovlanuprising, which mentioned feathertaildragons, that has been mentioned by various characters. However, the research has been missing since his death. Shortly after his son Brennan's death in 628 AU, Asher began to suffer from chest pains, which resulted in his untimely death more than a year prior to the events ofFourth Wing.

During this summer, Asher takes Violet to Unnbrish without Lilith and has their priestess partially dedicate Violet to Dunne.
However, an oracle said that Violet had multiple paths and could not be completely dedicated.
When they returned, Niara stopped speaking to them.Violet was a two-year-old and this was the time her hair started to grow in.
Lilith and Asher cut off communication with Niara.
She knew he was studying in the Isles.
After reaching the rank of Captain, Asher visited Hedotis and wrote,Hedotis: Isle of Hedon.After reaching the rank of Major, he travelled to Zehyllna and wrote,Zehyllna: Isle of Zihnal.
He began working as a scribe inthe Archiveswhen Lilith was stationed atBasgiath War Collegeas an instructor.
He raised his daughter, Violet, in the library.He tried to prepare Violet and Dain for the future he predicted before his death.
He considered his eldest children joining theRiders Quadranta failure of his.
He began aresearch projectabout the secondKrovlanuprising, which mentioned feathertaildragons, that has been mentioned by various characters.

Shortly after his son Brennan's death in 628 AU, Asher began to suffer from chest pains, which resulted in his untimely death more than a year prior to the events ofFourth Wing.

Fourth Wing.full_text: During his second year, Bodhi is the Tail Section Executive Officer forFourth Wing. Along with around two dozen other marked ones, Bodhi attends the meeting under the tree to discuss how to help the new first years.Violetdescribes his features as similar to Xaden's although softer. In the meeting he is quick to grin, tells Xaden that he thinks his words to one of the nervous first years are a little harsh, and also chides Imogen for not learning her lesson after breakingViolet'sarm. Bodhi is involved in weapon drops with Xaden and Garrick during his second year.Violetspots their three dragons flying back from a mission, and hears the three of them talking in hushed voices when they return. Bodhi argues that they should be doing more, andGarrickhisses back that they're doing everything they can. There has to be something more we can do Bodhi Durran toGarrick TavisandXaden Riorsonafter a secret mission,Fourth Wing Bodhi Durran toGarrick TavisandXaden Riorsonafter a secret mission,Fourth Wing AfterVioletis attacked by the unbonded cadets in her room, Bodhi, along withGarrickand two other marked ones, arrive to helpXaden, although he's already killed them all. Bodhi says, "let me guess, we're on clean-up?" They remove the bodies,and the next morning at Formation both Bodhi andGarrickstand up as witnesses to the attack. After the celebration for Reunification Day,Violetgoes looking for Xaden and finds Bodhi andGarrickwaiting for him at the end of the parapet. When she says to them, "tell me he's not out there," Bodhi responds, "I could tell you that, but I'd be lying." Garrick then reminds her thatXadendoesn't even want to see them, even though he and Bodhi are Xaden's best friends. The day after Reunification Day, the entire quadrant is called to an urgent, mandatory formation that turns out to be the last event of War Games. Bodhi, along with eight other riders includingLiam Mairi,Imogen Cardulo,Soleil Telery,Masen Sanborn,Garrick Tavis,EyaandViolet, are all part of the squadXadenselects for his "headquarters." They are assigned the post at Athebyne. Their riot stops at a lake close toAthebynefor water. When the fliers findXadenandVioletbehind a rock together, Bodhi is one of the first riders to arrive at the scene.They discover that they've walked into a trap and thatRessonis being attacked by the venin. Bodhi asks how many people live there, and is the first to say they should fight to save the civilians. "So we should just stand here while civilians die?" Bodhi Durran to Xaden Riorson on joining the battle in Resson,Fourth Wing Bodhi Durran to Xaden Riorson on joining the battle in Resson,Fourth Wing Two fliers warn them that joining the battle will be tantamount to a death sentence, and that they should leave.Imogen Cardulosays that defending the defenseless is what riders do, however, and Bodhi is quick to agree with her. "You saved every one of us here, cousin. ... And we're thankful. Now, I'd like to do what we've trained for, and if it means I don't go home, then I guess my soul will be commended to Malek. I wouldn't mind seeing my mother anyway." Bodhi andGarrickare also seen on foot after that chasing the venin from the clock tower with daggers in hand.One ofViolet's lightning strikes causes an explosion that distracts a rather large wyvern that had been on Bodhi's tail, giving him a moment's advantage and allowing his dragon to sink its teeth into the wyverns neck, killing it. Bodhi survives the battle, though his arm is broken in four places where a venin fractured it.WhenVioletis severely injured and they aren't sure what to do or where to take her, Bodhi snaps at someone commenting flippantly onViolet's lightning strikes. He supports takingViolettoAretia, saying toXaden"No need for orders, man. We'll save her." "She saved your fucking life. She savedallour lives." We also learn that he is still in a sling after the battle. Upon seeing Violet emerge from her room, Bodhi says that it's good to see her up and about again, and tellsXadenhe'll "fetch the back-up plan, and good luck."

Iron Flame.full_text: At the beginning of Iron Flame, Bodhi is still in a sling, and Violet notes that his "cloud of black curls" is freshly trimmed, and also that both he andImogenare comfortable atRiorson House.When theAssemblyargues againstVioletbeing allowed to overhear their conversation (and as to her worth), Bodhi is among those who defendViolet, saying "she fought at our side at Resson." Bodhi votes in favour of going back toBasgiath. He appears to have helped working onAndarna's harness as he remarks that they'll need to make some modifications on it before they can fly. Back atBasgiath, afterSolaskills many cadets in the formation afterParapetand leadership needs to do some restructuring, Bodhi is moved from Tail Section Leader to Flame. Bodhi, along withImogenand mostly likelyEya, continue with their operation smuggling weapons out ofBasgiath. After the first Battle Brief of the yearVioletapproaches Bodhi, telling him that she wants to help them, but Bodhi says that he's under direct instructions to keep her as far away from helping as possible.Violetquestions the fact thatXadenis still giving him orders but Bodhi can't be swayed, saying that despite being "the most reasonable one of the group," he "doesn't have a death wish," and that her job is to survive second year and strengthen her shields.During this conversation he scratches a pen into the cast on his arm, his injury still not healed by this point. Bodhi walksVioletout to the flight field before her first flight toSamarato visitXaden.Violetaccuses him of treating her like a letter, and he admits that she's the best way of getting information to Xaden. Bodhi avoids telling her anything of importance, but whenVioletmutters that dropping dead would be inconvenient to Xaden Bodhi lectures her that he's never seen his cousin this way with anyone before - not evenCatriona. He appears to immediately regret this slip, and asks "what are the chances you'll forget that between here and Samara?"He then continues to ask if there's not even the tiniest chance, because he's not in the mood to have his ass kicked by Xaden - not after fending off another assassination attempt. It turns out that it's the second time someone has tried to jump him in the bathing chamber this week, but he came out of it with only a bruise. "I completely eviscerated some asshole out of Second Wing while naked and only got a bruise. I'm fine." Bodhi Durran to Violet Sorrengail,Iron Flame Bodhi Durran to Violet Sorrengail,Iron Flame Vice CommandantBurton Varrishshows up beforeVioletcan fly away and insists upon searching her belongings, but Bodhi refuses to leave whenVarrishattempts to dismiss him, citing his position as her section leader. WhenVarrishfinds nothing and leaves,Violetaccuses Bodhi of knowing that was going to happen. Bodhi admits they used it as a test - "it was an experiment, and you were the control." Violet tells him to stop using her as a game piece, and he appears abashed, saying "fair point." AfterViolet's near burnout withVarrishandProfessor Carr, Bodhi arrives with Imogen and Eya to help her. Bodhi relays thatCuirsays she needs food to help with burnout. Bodhi tells her he will "handle it" and that it won't happen again, but relents to let Tairn take care of it. They all stay byViolet's side walking her back to the dorms, and when Violet whispers that she misses Xaden, Bodhi says, "me too." In an effort to protect Violet fromVarrish, Bodhi moves maneuvers for Flame Section, butImogencomments that if he continues to do so other teachers will begin to notice. WhenDain AetoschallengesVioletto a sparring match,Imogenruns for Bodhi ("the closest person to Xaden possible"). He argues against the match, pointing out thatVioletis still in a sling, but whenDainpulls rank on him Bodhi steps back, whispering thatXadenwill kill Dain for this. Bodhi watches the match, and when it's overViolettells him that Dain did not touch her, and therefore the secrets in her head remain safe. In the Battle Brief following second squad's successful escape from their first RSC interrogation, leaflets proclaiming "Zolya Falls to Dragon Fire" are on every seat -Violetimmediately looks to Bodhi andImogen, who exchange a panicked look. Bodhi shakes his head atViolet, indicating that he doesn't know what's happening, or what they're supposed to do.WhenVioletrealizes it wasXadenwho was injured in the attack atSamaraand runs out to the courtyard, Bodhi chases her. Bodhi votes in favour of going back toBasgiath.
He appears to have helped working onAndarna's harness as he remarks that they'll need to make some modifications on it before they can fly.
Back atBasgiath, afterSolaskills many cadets in the formation afterParapetand leadership needs to do some restructuring, Bodhi is moved from Tail Section Leader to Flame.
Bodhi, along withImogenand mostly likelyEya, continue with their operation smuggling weapons out ofBasgiath.

After the first Battle Brief of the yearVioletapproaches Bodhi, telling him that she wants to help them, but Bodhi says that he's under direct instructions to keep her as far away from helping as possible.Violetquestions the fact thatXadenis still giving him orders but Bodhi can't be swayed, saying that despite being "the most reasonable one of the group," he "doesn't have a death wish," and that her job is to survive second year and strengthen her shields.During this conversation he scratches a pen into the cast on his arm, his injury still not healed by this point.

Bodhi walksVioletout to the flight field before her first flight toSamarato visitXaden.Violetaccuses him of treating her like a letter, and he admits that she's the best way of getting information to Xaden.

Bodhi avoids telling her anything of importance, but whenVioletmutters that dropping dead would be inconvenient to Xaden Bodhi lectures her that he's never seen his cousin this way with anyone before - not evenCatriona.

He appears to immediately regret this slip, and asks "what are the chances you'll forget that between here and Samara?"He then continues to ask if there's not even the tiniest chance, because he's not in the mood to have his ass kicked by Xaden - not after fending off another assassination attempt.
It turns out that it's the second time someone has tried to jump him in the bathing chamber this week, but he came out of it with only a bruise.
"I completely eviscerated some asshole out of Second Wing while naked and only got a bruise.

I'm fine." Physical Description.full_text: Bodhi is described as handsome with a strong brow line, brown eyes, and tawny brown skin crowned by a cloud of black curls. He has a quick grin according toViolet. Lesser Magic.full_text: As a rider whose dragon is channeling through them, Bodhi is capable of performing lessermagic. With this channeling, Bodhi is able to do things like locking and unlocking doors without touching them, moving with preternatural speed, manipulate mage lights, and power ink pens. Lesser magic also allows Bodhi to placerunes.

Early life.full_text: While not much is known about Brennan's life prior to his conscription, Brennan was there when his mother was stationed inCalldyr.Brennan helped Violet wrap her joints,while Mira noted that she's always been the better sword fighter between the two of them growing up.One night when Brennan, his sisters, and his parents were stationed near the eastern border, his mother was so exhausted that she had bloodshot eyes. This had Violet shrieking and hiding behind her brother thinking their mother wasvenin. Brennan couldn't stop laughing at the occurrence. Brennan joinedBasgiath War Collegeto become adragonrider.Professor Kaoridescribed him as a spectacular rider and a good man.He wrote the Book of Brennanduring his time at Basgiath. He gave this book to Mira to help her, and later Mira passed it down to Violet, saying that Brennan would want her to have it. Five years prior to the start ofFourth Wing,during theTyrrish Rebellionat theBattle of Aretia, battle reports mentioned that Brennan had been shot with a crossbolt byFen Riorsonand that Brennan's close friendNaolinhad tried and failed to save him. Both Naolin and Brennan were reported dead. According to Violet, all of his belongings had been burned and no one has dared mention him or his dragon in the five years since they died. She also noted that their mother loved him most out of the three siblings, and alluded to the fact that their father's chest pains began because of the loss of their son.

Fourth Wing.full_text: Five years after his death, the Book of Brennan helps Violet to survive the first year at Basgiath. This book includes information on how to discover which cadets she would be sparring against ahead of time, as well as other survival skills. When Violet arrives unconscious atAretiaafter being poisoned by a venin, Brennan is quick to mend her. After she wakes up, he welcomes her as a part ofthe Revolution. She is shocked to learn he is still alive.

Iron Flame.full_text: Brennan explains that he woke up on a cliffside in the aftermath of the Battle of Aretia and that Marbh was wounded. According to him, there were dragons in Aretia that hid the two of them in a network of caves within the valley. Brennan later hid with the civilians who survived the destruction of Aretia. He changed his last name to "Aisereigh," which means "resurrection," as a precaution against those who held a grudge or vendetta against Lilith. He eventually became a ranking member ofthe Assembly, a group that reside inRiorson Houseand are secretly working to helpPoromishandNavarriancitizens against the threat of venin, and earned the rank of Lieutenant Colonel; though he credits the title to the repeated early demise of his superiors. He had been keeping track of Violet and expressed relief at her survivingThreshingbut admitted he hadn't heard anything after that untilXadenshowed up with an injured Violet after theBattle of Resson. During their first honest discussion after she wakes up, Brennan asks about Mira and expresses regret that he had to hide the truth from their other sibling as well. He remained in Aretia as Violet returned to Basgiath and the two didn't see each other again until after Violet escapedVarrish's torture and leads half theRider's Quadrantinto joining the Revolution. Shortly after, Mira also abandoned her post inSamarawhen their mother gave every Navarrian rider the choice to stay or leave. In doing so, Mira discovered the fact that Brennan was alive and promptly punched him in the face. Finally reunited after six years, the three siblings share a complicated relationship with one another, equally supportive and antagonizing. Brennan accompanies his sisters toCordynand helps fight the venin that had been trapped in the Rybestad Chest before negotiating a deal withViscount Tecarusfor hisluminary. Brennan later declines Navarre's plea for help during a meeting with GeneralMelgrenon behalf of the Assembly. Despite this, Violet and Xaden lead a riot back to Basgiath to protect thewardstoneand Brennan ultimately changes his mind and follows them with the rest of the Aretian cadets who had previously defected from Navarre. During the Battle of Basgiath, Brennan uses hissignetto mend the broken wardstone, and then nearly burns out while trying to mend Violet in the midst of her imbuing the wardstone. The two siblings, exhausted from their abilities, were held back while their mother sacrificed her life to imbue the wardstone and re-raise the wards against the Venin army. Mira, having not been present, initially accused Brennan of being at fault for Lilith's death and the three siblings end up separated with the last mention of Brennan being him sitting on the steps of the administration building while giving out orders.

Personality.full_text: He's a problem solver, and likes to tilt his head when he's thinking. He is also known as a brilliant strategist, knowing what to do even under stress. Kaori describes Brennan as a spectacular rider and a good man. Brennan doesnt want anyone to die for him, as its not in his nature. He is more about getting work done than celebrating it. He has a tendency to rub his thumb along his chin when he is nervous, just as he rubs his thumb over the bridge of his nose when he is frustrated. He is a kind man, always caring for others and wanting to help. He always used to take time to help Violet wrap her joints. He easily shows a grin when around his sisters, and has teased Violet about her relationship with Xaden. Brennan values loyalty to the cause over moral duty.

Violet Sorrengail.full_text: When Violet was still a child, Brennan always took the time to help wrap her joints. She hid behind her older brother when she thought their mother was venin, causing Brennan to laugh. He also witnessed eight-year-old Violet refusing to eat dinner. While at Basgiath, Violet discovers his journal, the Book of Brennan, which was dedicated to her older sister Mira and helps Violet survive. After the Battle ofResson, she reunites with Brennan who mended her wounded and poisoned body. She feels lucky to see her brother being alive, but at the same time strange since six years have passed. Brennan did admit to Violet that the choice he made, faking his own death, was a decision he questioned himself every single day since making it. He also teased Violet about her love life with Xaden. They are close siblings and love one another.

Lilith Sorrengail.full_text: Brennan was her favorite child, and she loved him the most. She could not let go of the grief that she felt losing her first born child. No one was allowed to mention him or his dragon. When she reunites with him six years later at Athebyne, she was in shock seeing her son stand in front of her alive and well, tears falling from her eyes. Later when Brennan goes to Basgiath, she sees him again. She looks at Brennan as if he's an hallucination. Brennan comes to hate his mother when he learns about the lies she told and learns about the things she did in his name following his presumed death. She later sacrifices herself for her children. Her last words being "you're everything we dreamed you would be. All three of you." Brennan holds her lifeless body in his arms.

Biography.full_text: Burton Varrish was ariderwith the title of Major. Sometime beforeIron Flame, he was stationed at the Samara outpost under the command ofLieutenant Colonel Degrensi. He specialized in interrogation, due to hissignetability of weakness detection, but after his methods led to the death of three consecutive prisoners, Lieutenant Colonel Degrensi sent a request toGeneral Melgrenfor Varrish to be reassigned from an active wing until further notice. He was assigned as the new Vice Commandant of Basgiath War College, under the command ofCommandant Panchek. His first order of business was delivering missives toVioletandXaden, allowing them each only two days of leave once every 14 days, to be used only to fly with their dragon directly to and from the other's current duty station or location, and noting that any other absence from classes or duty would be considered a punishable offense. Varrish was almost killed byTairneanachwhenSolasnearly friedVioletand everyone else in the wing. However,Tairneanachflew in which scared seemingly every first-year, but did manage to getSolasaway from the group.Tairneanachthen toldVioletthat ifSolasgot near her again, that he would personally ingest Varrish and let him digest within. While at Basgiath, Varrish regularly made cadets searchViolet's bags or demanded she take off her flight jacket for further inspection. Varrish demanded that Violet bringAndarnato flight lessons while Andarna was in the dreamless sleep. The first time Violet disobeyed, Varrish sent her for an extra training lesson withCarrand pushed her to near burn out.The second time Andarna did not appear at flight lessons, Varrish told Violet he was charging her with dereliction of duty and told her to fly to her training location with Carr. Tairneanach refused to obey and wrap his mouth around Solas' neck. He did not remove his teeth until Varrish apologized to Violet on his knees. After Violet was poisoned byNolonand brought to the interrogation chambers, Varrish personally interrogated her, leaving bruises and dislocated bones on her. He revealed to Violet that his signet allows him to read weaknesses of others, and that her biggest weaknesses are the people she loves. He brought inDainto read Violet's mind against her will, but abruptly was betrayed by Dain, who slashed him with a dagger.Varrish ended up chained to the interrogation chair by Xaden's shadows, and Violet killed him by shoving the dagger through his chest.

Iron Flame.full_text: The first mention of Catriona is fromBodhi, who tells Violet he's "never seen Xaden like this, even with Catriona." Violet is immediately suspicious, but Bodhi asks her to forget about it. Catriona flies as part of Syrena's drift to receive a weapons drop, near an unnamed Pomorish village, delivered by Xaden andViolet Sorrengail. After the dark wilders destroyed Cliffsbane, Catriona took up residence in her uncle's palace. She receivesBrennan Sorrengail,Mira Sorrengail, Violet, and Xaden as they arrive to negotiate the terms of an agreement to procure theluminary. Showing them to their rooms to change for dinner, she makes snide comments to Violet, aimed at undermining her and Xaden's relationship. After the agreement with Tecarus is reached, she joins the other fliers from their academy in the journey to Aretia via the Medaro Pass by scaling the cliffs of Dralor. Her drift is assigned to work together with Violet's squad. She is paired specifically withRhiannon Matthias. When making a crossing, drift memberLuellafails to make the jump, and dies. Catriona blames Violet for dropping her, and vows to kill her for it. They are interrupted by the surprise arrival of four riderless Wyvern that were then killed by Violet. In Aretia, Catriona does not want to get along with the riders, choosing instead to worsen relationships between the two groups by posting inflammatory material, such as a list of fliers that Mira had killed.She also appeared at Xaden's door wearing a see-though silk gown at dawn, although it is Violet who answers the door. After it is announced that fliers would also be subject to the Dragon Rider's Codex, and that grievances between cadets can be solved with a challenge, Catriona challenges Violet. As both were trained by Xaden, neither has the upper-hand. Catriona repeatedly taunts Violet throughout the match about her previous relationship with Xaden, and saying that Violet was just a "placeholder for him to fuck". The fliers' drifts and the riders' squads are formally merged, with Catriona's drift formally joining Violet's squad. Violet presents her with the Iron Squad patch. They attend classes, spar, run, attend Battle Brief and have their meals together. Despite this, she still hates being in the Second Squad. To improve squad unity, Rhiannon assigns fliers and riders to be study partners, with Catriona paired up with Rhiannon. When Violet discovers how to raise the wards in Aretia, Catriona objects on behalf of the fliers, protesting that the wards would effectively stop fliers from channeling, making them powerless. The riders argue that raising the wards has long been their objective, even before the fliers arrived. Violet says that she has to tell the Assembly about her discovery, but is holding off so she can talk to the fliers first. Catriona does not appear to be moved by this. Rhiannon assigns Violet, Sloane, Visia, and Catriona to the same group for squad exercises with the other Sections. They are tasked to find and close more runed boxes that the other squads.

Personality.full_text: Ambitious, power-hungry, and ruthless. Catriona sees her previous betrothal to Xaden as a way of securing political power and her own future. She does not back down easily, and considers Violet an opponent she can clash with despite seeing the depth of her power. In her plan to win Xaden back, she attempts to come between Violet and Xaden's relationship. She speaks down to Violet, planting insecurities in her head about her relationship. She makes many references to her previous relationship with Xaden, including suggesting to Violet, who was wearing a black dress, that Xaden would prefer a colourful dress. She is also not above using under-hand digs or being disrespectful, calling out both Violet's mother,Lilith Sorrengail, and Mira's alleged complicity in covering up the truth about the Venin. She uses her gift of heightened emotions to further amplify the feelings of doubt and insecurity in Violet. She has appeared at Xaden's door in a see-through silk robe at dawn. As a flier, she is loyal and collaborative with other fliers, trading runes with them. With the other riders in the Second Squad, she is making small efforts to trust them more, and be more civil with them.

Xaden Riorson.full_text: Catriona and Xaden both came from aristocratic families and were betrothed when she turned 20. They quickly realized that they were not compatible, and Xaden broke off the betrothal a year prior to the events ofIron Flame. TheRybestad Chestwas gifted to Tecarus as part of the betrothal. After The Revolution agrees to Tecarus's terms by accepting the 100 flier cadets that escaped the fall of Cliffsbane Academy, Catriona is relocated along with her drift to Riorson House in Aretia. While living there Catriona repeatedly attempts to win Xaden back, often clashing with Violet to break them up. She later admits during a sparring match against Violet that she has no interest in being with him romantically but that she needs to be with him to secure her crown. Xaden admits that while he does not care if Catriona lives or dies, she is still a necessary ally, and that they could not afford to make an enemy out of Syrena. Sloane describes their relationship as "toxic".

Violet Sorrengail.full_text: Catriona does not like Violet because Violet is in the way of her goal, while Violet is jealous about her previous relationship with Xaden. With every comment towards Violet, she aims to discredit her relationship with Xaden. She was aware of Violet before Violet was aware of her, and uses this to get under Violet's skin. This almost succeeds, with Violet having to make a noticeable effort to control her signet power, so she does not kill her. They are forced to work together after Catriona's drift is assigned to Violet's squad to make the climb through the Medaro Pass. She blames Violet for failing to save one of her friends, Luella, who failed to make the jump across. She vows to kill Violet for this. Although both despise each other, they have a moment of truce each day during morning formation, when the names of those who died are read out. They understand each other's worry for their siblings, who are fighting on the frontlines. During her challenge with Violet, she constantly taunts her about her previous relationship with Xaden, referring specifically to the times where they had sexual relations. When Violet gains the upper hand and begins to choke her out, she would rather die than tap out. In the later parts of Iron Flame and during Onyx Storm, they have a much more warmer relationship.

Early Life.full_text: As Commandant at Basgiath War College,ColonelLyron Panchek is responsible for leading both the firstand lastformation of the year, welcoming new cadets and congratulating graduating ones. He also attends formations where there is important news, but otherwise avoids formation. During Mira's time in the quadrant, Panchek sends an official notice to General Sorrengail notifying her that Mira survived an assassination attempt. He is bonded to a green clubtaildragon.When he was a lieutenant, Panchek wroteTactics, A Personal Memoir.

Fourth Wing.full_text: According toTara, rumor has it that Panchek wantsGeneral Sorrengail'sjob and then GeneralMelgren's, butViolet Sorrengailsays it's unlikely he would ever ascend to that position due to General Melgren'ssignetallowing him to foresee any assassination attempts. Panchek is among the leadership on the dais at Threshing. He is shocked when Violet rides in on Tairn. WhenXaden RiorsonaccusesAmber Mavisof breaking the Codex, Panchek is the leader to oversee the proceedings, though the wingleaders are the ones making the decision. When Panchek, along withColonel Aetos, runs into Xaden and Violet on their way to the flight field one day in March, Panchek ignores them. Panchek is the one to announce the beginning of the final task of the squad battle: for squads to find and acquire, by any means necessary, the one thing most advantageous to enemies. He warns the cadets not to try to present a dragon as their find. While second squad is brainstorming,Ridoc Gamlynsuggests stealing Panchek's underwear but is quickly shot down. Panchek also begins the formation where Colonel Aetos introduces the final event of War Games.

Iron Flame.full_text: Panchek is shocked whenXaden Riorsonreturns for graduation when he was reported for the death roll after theBattle of Resson. After the death roll is corrected, he presides over the graduation ceremony. A new Vice-Commandant,Major Burton Varrish, is appointed at the beginning of Violet's second year. He reports only to Panchek. During the first formation of the year, Varrish's dragon,Solas, takes out at least half of Third Squad behind Violet's squad. Panchek orders the cadets back into formation from where they have scattered in shock, but when he returns to the podium his hands are shaking. When Violet departs without leave after being tipped off that Xaden was hurt at Samara,Professor Kaoriadvocates to Panchek that she should not be punished for the choice her dragon made. Panchek agreed with Kaori's expert opinion and cleared her of all charges. During the Battle at Basgiath, Panchek doubts that cadets will be able to defend against the second wave of venin and wyvern that are waiting to attack. Xaden silences him with a cold, menacing tone.

Onyx Storm.full_text: XadenandSgaeylare ensnared, in a giant weighted net and are confronted by the Sage,Berwyn, who appears to have lived through what Xaden thought was his death (Iron Flame). Panchek is there and his green clubtail is also trapped. Xaden quickly realizes that Panchek is with theVeninand thinks "Pancheks cowering, traitorous ass," realizing Panchek is the one who has been leaking information. Panchek is upset with the Sage for trapping his dragon and begins to argue with him, confident that Berwyn will not hurt him because Panchek is the only one who can give Berwyn access to hisson. With two alloy-hilted daggers in hand, Berwyn "stabs deep between the dragons scales, and it desiccates, green draining from its scales and shrinking in on itself to a husk."

Quotes.full_text: As the Codex says, now you begin the true crucible! You will be tested by your superiors, hunted by your peers, and guided by your instincts. If you survive to Threshing, and if you are chosen, you will be riders. Then we'll see how many of you make it to graduation. Lyron Panchek, Welcoming Speech for New Cadets,Fourth Wing, Chapter 3 Lyron Panchek, Welcoming Speech for New Cadets,Fourth Wing, Chapter 3 Beyond military commendations, there are no words of praise for riders. Our reward for a job well done is living to see the next duty station, the next rank. In keeping with our traditions and standards, those of you who have completed your third year will now be commissioned as lieutenants in the army of Navarre. Step forward when you name is called to receive your orders. You have until morning to depart for your new duty stations. Iron Flame.full_text: Last time I checked, youre a section leader. Dain narrows his eyes on Bodhi. And your cousin isnt her wingleader anymore. I am. Dain Aetos to Bodhi Durran,Iron Flame Dain Aetos to Bodhi Durran,Iron Flame He agrees not to reach for Violet's face and check her memories. He's fast and immaculate on the mat. Dain proudly points out that Violet has improved with her sparring. Violet angrily rubs it in stating she was trained by Xaden. He pins her down whilst her dagger is pointed against his throat. He insists on his point only needing to talk to Violet. I just want to talk to you, he whispers, his face inches from mine.The pain is nothing compared to the ice-cold fear of having his hands this close to me. And I just want you to leave me the fuck alone. I hold my knife steady right where he can feel it. Dain Aetos and Violet Sorrengail in the sparring gym,Iron Flame The pain is nothing compared to the ice-cold fear of having his hands this close to me. And I just want you to leave me the fuck alone. I hold my knife steady right where he can feel it. Dain Aetos and Violet Sorrengail in the sparring gym,Iron Flame Violet accuses him of sending their squad to die during war games, but Dain clarifies that he had no such intention. He said he is going to miss Violet and any chance of a romantic relation he had with her. He then questions her about Xaden's scars and gives her the shocking fact that it was, her mother who did that. " Your mother did it. " Dain Aetos to Violet Sorrengail, sparring, Iron Flame Dain Aetos to Violet Sorrengail, sparring, Iron Flame Dain is shocked to see a bruised Violet and her friends when he is called during RSC. " Regulations states that a rider should be healthy before beginning interrogation assessment ", Dain barks, ripping his gaze from mine to address Varrish. " Cadet Sorrengail is clearly not healthy Dain Aetos to Varrish, Interrogation Chamber, Iron Flame Dain Aetos to Varrish, Interrogation Chamber, Iron Flame Varrish taunts him about his strict adherence to the codex. Dain is furious to be present in the chamber and angrily demands the reason for it. He's ordered by Varrish to use his signet on Violet, but he blatantly refuses. Varrish coaxes him further, stating that Dain could learn why she chose him - Xaden over him further prying on his insecurities. Dain holds his ground and denies participating in this assessment. " I will not participate in an interrogation assessment of a caded with prior injury " Dain Aetos to Varrish, Interrogation Chamber, Iron Flame Dain Aetos to Varrish, Interrogation Chamber, Iron Flame When Violet is told to join her squad for the rest of formation, Dain breaks formation to speak with her. Violet, however, feels betrayed by the nonconsensual use of his signet, which directly led to the deaths of Liam and Soleil. Because of this, Violet makes a spectacle telling him to never touch her again otherwise she'll cut his hands off. Xaden escalates the public falling out by making it seem romantic in nature in an effort to keep people from connecting the dissolution of their friendship with theBattle of Resson.Shocked by the outburst, Dain is embarrassed and upset. He talks back to Xaden, who reinforces Violet's rejection, and then leans in and secretly mentions the empty post atAthebyne. Dain seems to still be caught off guard, and he has no response but to fall back into formation. The next time Violet sees Dain is when he is leaving a leadership meeting with Rhiannon, Sawyer, and Bodhi and Violet and Imogen are getting ready to go on a run. Later in Battle Brief, Dain rebukes Caroline Ashton for recommending retaliation against a gryphon attack. He tells her "that's not our way" and that the codex forbids retaliation. After Violet kills her would-be assassin, Dain checks on her frantically, but she refuses to let him help her up, not wanting him to touch her. Dain reluctantly backs off and directs the removal of Nadine's body. During a special flight maneuvers class, third years join Violet's class to demonstrate, and Dain demonstrates the running landing for all cadets, withKaoripraising his execution. In Aretia, during his time there after joining the Revolution, Dain keeps his distance both physically and emotionally from Violet. When she is working on translating the journals, Violet asks Dain for help because his specialty is Krovlish. He is still wary of Violet, and asks if she sent for him of her "own volition." She asks for help and he immediately agrees. And just like that, I remember why he used to be one of my favorite people on the continent. - Violet, after he agrees to help her - Violet, after he agrees to help her While Jesinia and Violet think they are looking for "iron rain," Dain is the one who realizes they mistranslated the word "rain," and it is meant to be "flame." He and Violet talk some, with her asking him why he stopped listening to her. He says it was when he said goodbye to her on his conscription day. He admits he was "pissed and scared" when she crossed parapet, and determined to ensure she was not on the death roll like so many of his friends. He also wanted to give her what she always thought she wanted (to be a scribe.) She says she wasn't mad about that, but rather that he was so "pigheaded" thinking he knew what was best for her, unlike when they were kids. They talk about how Basgiath changed them. Dain tries to apologize for the part he played in Liam's death, but Violet ignores him at first. She asks him if he read her memories every time he touched her face, and he says no, that he was just used to touching her face so much. He says he read her memories by accident the first time. He tells her that he "fucked up and trusted my dad when I should have trusted your judgement." He imbues the stone while Violet says she may never be able to forgive him, and she doesn't want to hear him talk about Liam or Soleil ever again. He agrees and says he will continue to help and follow those conditions. Dain asks Violet if she is in love with Xaden. She says she is and Dain says if Violet trusts Xaden, then he will too.Leaving their former childhood friendship in a fragile state. He continues imbuing the ward in Aretia along with Violet and Xaden, so it is ready when they need to raise it. Dain is there when the dragons breathe fire into the chamber to get the wards up, and his dragon Cath is the Red den representative of the six dragons there. When the ward goes up, Dain is as excited as Violet. When the riders arrive at Basgiath to defend it from the venin, Dain meets up with Violet and Mira to confront their mother. When General Sorrengail denies them, Dain offers to take them to the ward chamber, since he knows where it is because of his father. The general agrees to go with them, and Dain leads the way, opening the secret tunnel for them.

And just like that, I remember why he used to be one of my favorite people on the continent.

- Violet, after he agrees to help her - Violet, after he agrees to help her While Jesinia and Violet think they are looking for "iron rain," Dain is the one who realizes they mistranslated the word "rain," and it is meant to be "flame." He and Violet talk some, with her asking him why he stopped listening to her.
He says it was when he said goodbye to her on his conscription day.
He admits he was "pissed and scared" when she crossed parapet, and determined to ensure she was not on the death roll like so many of his friends.

He also wanted to give her what she always thought she wanted (to be a scribe.) She says she wasn't mad about that, but rather that he was so "pigheaded" thinking he knew what was best for her, unlike when they were kids.
They talk about how Basgiath changed them.
Dain tries to apologize for the part he played in Liam's death, but Violet ignores him at first.
She asks him if he read her memories every time he touched her face, and he says no, that he was just used to touching her face so much.
He says he read her memories by accident the first time.

He tells her that he "fucked up and trusted my dad when I should have trusted your judgement." He imbues the stone while Violet says she may never be able to forgive him, and she doesn't want to hear him talk about Liam or Soleil ever again.
He agrees and says he will continue to help and follow those conditions.
Dain asks Violet if she is in love with Xaden.
She says she is and Dain says if Violet trusts Xaden, then he will too.Leaving their former childhood friendship in a fragile state.
He continues imbuing the ward in Aretia along with Violet and Xaden, so it is ready when they need to raise it.
Dain is there when the dragons breathe fire into the chamber to get the wards up, and his dragon Cath is the Red den representative of the six dragons there.
When the ward goes up, Dain is as excited as Violet.
When the riders arrive at Basgiath to defend it from the venin, Dain meets up with Violet and Mira to confront their mother.
When General Sorrengail denies them, Dain offers to take them to the ward chamber, since he knows where it is because of his father.
The general agrees to go with them, and Dain leads the way, opening the secret tunnel for them.

He likes order and detests anything that doesn't fit neatly into his plan. Violet Sorrengail.full_text: I can't lose you, Violet ... I just... can't. Dain to Violet,Fourth Wing, Chapter 9 Dain to Violet,Fourth Wing, Chapter 9 Violet and Dain have known each other for roughly 15 years at the start ofFourth Wing. According to Violet, aside from Mira, Dain is the one person who knows Violet the best on the entirecontinent. The two met during childhood around the time that Violet was 5, and Dain 6, when his father Colonel Aetos became her mother, General Lilith Sorrengail's, aide. The two often traveled to the same outposts due to the nature of their parent's careers. No matter where they were stationed they always managed to find places to swim and climb trees, and once their parents moved to Basgiath they frequently went swimming in the Iakobos River. According to Violet, Dain would always bring her to see thehealerswhen she inevitably hurt herself.She teases him that after spending so much time together he's seen her in all types of clothing including swimwear, tunics, and ballgowns but wonders if it's riding leathers that turns him on. Dain tries to scoff but blushes at the insinuation, and later, when Violet jokes about what she can do with her tongue, Dain's gaze heats with the insinuation implying that her unrequited feelings may not be so one-sided. Leading up to the events ofFourth Wing, Violet hadn't seen Dain in the year since he joined the Riders Quadrant. She thinks about how she's missed him and their friendship, as well as all the moments she thought it might turn into something more under the right circumstances. Growing up, he looked at her like she was someone worth noticing.Once they see each other again, Dain remarks that she's still a smart-ass as he takes her back tohis dorm roomto afford her some privacy while she wraps her knee as a result of Parapet. While in the room, Violet notes that Dain still has a tome on the Krovlan language she gave him prior to his Conscription Day, something he had to have carried across the parapet in his rucksack, as riders are only allowed to keep what they can carry.As she wraps her knee, the two of them admit to missing one another in the year that they've been apart. His composure falters during Violet's sparring assessment againstImogenand he carries her to the healers, which Violet sees as him revealing their friendship to all. He says he doesn't regret carrying her off because she means something to him. However, once with the healers, he asks for her tonotbe mended so the injury will seem severe enough to get her admitted into the Scribe Quadrant. Violet does not like this idea and tells him she will not go to the Scribe Quadrant. They argue about it, with Dain insisting she needs to leave, and Violet refusing. Dain begs Violet to switch quadrants if he cannot protect her. He says he should have stopped Imogen from injuring Violet so severely. Violet knows he is feeling guilty and shoulders the blame for her injury "like he always does." During the first few weeks of term, Dain escorts Violet to her morning duty everyday, though he swears he does it because it's the only time he gets to see her when he's not considered her squad leader.It's during this time that he asks her about her sex life and if she's been with anyone since entering the quadrant, alluding to the fact by his reaction that he has feelings for her.Despite the classified status of his signet, he excitedly tells Violet what it is. After Threshing, Dain kisses Violet for the first time and later on, he tells her that they cannot pursue a relationship because it would be frowned upon for a first-year to sleep with older riders, but that they can still be best friends. Before Amber's execution, Dain attempts, and fails, to violate Violet's privacy by reading her memories without asking. After Amber's execution, Dain alternates being cold and then warm to Violet, which the latter does not find comforting at all and began to question if Dain is still trustworthy. Over the course ofFourth Wing, he becomes more and more over-protective about Violet, and refuses to believe that she is just as, if not more, capable than everyone else, and continually tries to convince her to switch to the Scribe Quadrant. There are a few moments where his lack of confidence in her causes her trust in him, and their friendship, to waiver. This results in his friendship with Violet falling apart because he is so overprotective that he is unable to see or accept who she really is, and continues to see her as broken and fragile, in need of help and protection, even though she is able to hold her own. InIron Flame, after his unintentional participation the causes ofLiamsdeath, Dains connection with Violet is far past strained, with Violet showing him outright hostility. When she wasnt threatening him, Violet was ignoring him as much as possible. He made many efforts to extend an olive branch to Violet, like ensuring Sloane was added to their wing, but none of it change how Violet felt about him. Finally Dain challenges Violet on the sparring mat in an official capacity as the wing leader, which she couldnt refuse. During this fight she finally speaks to him, and angrily tells him just what shes been thinking about him stealing her memories, violating her privacy, and how his actions lead to Liam andSoleil dying. Dani surrenders to Violet and walks away, clearly disappointed and upset with the state of their relationship. Later on, during Violets RSC course, Varrish tries to push Dain to use his powers on Violet, but Dain refuses to by citing rules of the codex which would prevent him from doing so. Violet is relieved by Dain doing the right thing in this moment, but not enough so to forget the past. Things escalate when Violet is arrested by Varrish after stealing from the royal library in thearchives. When Dain is brought in to see her he is clearly disturbed by the state she is in, but knowing what she is accused of Dain does use his signant on her. Violet tries to show Dain the parts of her memories that matter most to her, like the terror that is the venin, and all the pain and torture shes been through. In the end Dain saves Violet, and stabsVarrish, saving the finishing blow for Violet.XadenandGarrickshow up at this point to rescue Violet, and after she vouches for him to the others Dain decided to go with them toAretia.

Iron Flame.full_text: Eya was a rider in First Squad, Flame Section. She was one of the riders who fought atResson. She was upset that another rider defendedGeneral Sorrengaillafter theBattle of Ressonand was reluctant to return to Basgiath, not trusting that they wouldn't be executed for their actions. Two weeks into the year, Eya and Imogen were attacked coming out of a briefing for third-years. WhenViolet Sorrengailwas suffering from burnout, Eya joined Imogen and Bodhi to help her.After that, she and Violet were friendly. Some time later, Violet saw Eya with a black eye and possible broken nose, but she did not find out how that happened. Toward the end of Threshing, Violet took over the watch at the top of the academic tower. Eya was on watch before her. As they exchanged pleasantries, they were attacked by four infantry soldiers brandishing shortswords. Eya and Violet stood back to back to face them, Eya fighting with a hatchet. Eya killed one of the assassins before being stabbed in the middle of her chest by one of the soldier's swords.

main.full_text: Fen RiorsonwasXaden Riorson's father and the leader of theTyrrish Rebellion. He died during the final days of the rebellion.
paragraphs: Fen RiorsonwasXaden Riorson's father and the leader of theTyrrish Rebellion.
He died during the final days of the rebellion.

Biography.full_text: Fen went into the infantry and hoped his son,Xaden Riorsonwould too.While much of his life is unknown, he did have a sister and nephew,Bodhi Durran. As the Duke of Aretia,Fen entered a contractual relationship with Xaden's mother to give him an heir. After fulfilling the contract his wife left, leaving Fen and Xaden behind in Riorson House, Aretia. In the years following his wife's absence Fen began to gather allies as he attempted to secede from Navarre, going as far as to enter his son in a similar betrothal contract withCatriona Cordella,third in line for Poromiel's throne.Fen was thus most known for beginning and leading what is known as the Tyrrish Rebellion, or Apostasy. According to battlefield reports Fen was responsible for shootingBrennan Sorrengailin the chest with a crossbolt during the Battle of Aretia,and was subsequently apprehended by GeneralLilith Sorrengail.During his interrogation, Fen accusedKing Tauri, and those who came before him, of an unspeakable conspiracy. In his last days of interrogation, Fen Riorson lost touch with reality, railing against the kingdom of Navarre. He accused King Tauri, and all who came before him, of a conspiracy so vast, so unspeakable, that it does not bear repeating by this historian. The execution was swift and merciful for a madman who cost untold lives. Navarre, An Unedited HistorybyColonel Lewis Markham Navarre, An Unedited HistorybyColonel Lewis Markham He was executed byCodagh's dragonfire along with the rest of the rebellions leadership.His name was on the death roll from the Calldyr executions. Third Year.full_text: During his third year, Garrick is appointed as Section Leader for Fourth Wing, Flame Section - a position which puts him belowXadenin the chain of command and aboveDain Aetos(after he switches withAura Beinhavenand is appointed as Leader of the Second Squad within Garrick's Section). Although it is not confirmed, the day after Conscription,Violet SorrengailseesXadenat the top of the stairs (next to the place she was meeting withDain Aetos) talking to a third year who could be Garrick. Around a week after Assessment Day, Garrick is among the two dozen marked ones that attend the secret meeting by the Iakobos River to discuss the situation of the new first years. Violet notes during this scene that Garrick's voice is loud enough to be heard over the noise made by the river as he mentions the loss of two marked ones to the Parapet (Jace Sutherland and Dougal Luperco). Learning that numerous first-years struggle with combat, Garrick offers to train them, along withImogen Cardulo, as Xaden considers them the best fighters among them. Garrick is our best fighter, but Imogen is right up there with him, and shes a hell of a lot more patient. So the four of you split yourselves up between the two of them for training." Xaden on Garrick and Imogen's suitability to train first-years,Fourth Wing Xaden on Garrick and Imogen's suitability to train first-years,Fourth Wing During the same meeting, when the subject ofViolet Sorrengailis brought up,Imogenpoints out that they deserve to take their revenge on her forLilith Sorrengail's involvement in their parents' execution, but Garrick argues that they should not resume to such actions because Violet had nothing to do with what happened to their parents and blaming her would be similar to how Navarre punished them after theTyrrish rebellionfor their parents' actions. So we get conscripted because of what our parents did years ago and shoved into this death sentence of a college Imogen starts.In case you didnt notice, shes in the same death sentence of a college, Garrick retorts. Seems like shes already suffering the same fate. Garrick arguing withImogenaboutViolet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing In case you didnt notice, shes in the same death sentence of a college, Garrick retorts. Seems like shes already suffering the same fate. Garrick arguing withImogenaboutViolet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing During challenges, after Xaden decided to give Violet a 'proper' sparring lesson because she can't rely on poisoning her opponents forever, Garrick teases his best friend, pointing out how obvious Xaden's infatuation with the first-year actually is. Two months into the school year, as she walks through the courtyard,Violet Sorrengailsees Garrick, Xaden andBodhi Durranreturning very late from the flight field, discussing how their efforts to help the gryphon fliers might not be enough after their weapon delivery at Athebyne that night. Garrick is present during theGauntlettrial to oversee how the cadets in his Section fare. He is quick to lash out atAmber Maviswhen she objects to the wayVioletcompleted the obstacle course by using a dagger, pointing out that it is Xaden's responsibility to deal with problems within the Fourth Wing, not hers. Back the hell up, Mavis, Garrick threatens, the sun flashing off the two swords the curly-haired section leader keeps strapped to his back as he puts his body between Amber and Xaden. I dont take kindly to calling anyone in my section a cheater, Garrick warns, his massive shoulders blocking her from view as he turns. And my wingleader will handle any rule-breaking in his own wing. Garrick toAmber Mavis,Fourth Wing Garrick toAmber Mavis,Fourth Wing After everyone crosses the Gauntlet (or dies trying), Garrick organizes the squads within his section for Presentation and Violet notes that "his leadership style is more mission first, niceties last". After Graduation.full_text: As everyone who left with Xaden for Athebyne was presumed dead, Command is forced to hand-write on the spot orders for the three third-years -Xaden Riorson, Garrick Tavis andMasen Sanborn. There were no other choices by the time they were allowed to pick, but Garrick and Xaden somehow managed to get appointed to the same outpost, at Samara, the "easternmost outpost of the Southern Wing, where the borders of Krovla and Braevick provinces intersect". Before they were allowed to leaveBasgiath War College, all the graduates who had a rebellion relic were thoroughly searched as Command started to suspect their smuggling operation. Samara is described as one of the cruelest outposts there are in Navarre and both Xaden and Garrick have to prove themselves all over again, like in Basgiath.Xadenmentions during one of Violet's visits that Garrick received a somewhat warmer welcome at Samara compared to him, as his father was not the Great Betrayer, but that also came with the disadvantage that the other riders have no qualms sharing a bathroom with him, as they do with Xaden. I think the last name does it more than the relic. The older riders are easier on Garrick, which Im thankful for. Xaden on Garrick's treatment at Samara,Iron Flame Xaden on Garrick's treatment at Samara,Iron Flame During another one ofViolet'svisits at Samara, an unscheduled one following some disturbing news about an attack on the outpost during which Xaden was said to have been injured, she walks in on Xaden and Garrick as they are sparring with their swords. During said fight, Xaden teasingly lectures Garrick on being too slow and needing to get faster, before he "nails Garrick in the face with his elbow, sending him tumbling to the ground", thus ending the training session. While at Samara, Garrick and Xaden continue the weapon smuggling operation, counting on Bodhi and Imogen sending the weapons from the forge at Basgiath through Violet asTairn'ssaddle is not checked byVarrishand his subordinates. They have selected a location close to Athebyne to drop the shipments. Figuring out that something is wrong when he doesn't hear from Violet, Xaden, along with Garrick, deserts and set off forBasgiath. In order to create a diversion, they have allies drop wyvern carcasses to different outpost throughout Navarre to expose the truth aboutVeninsand forcing all the leaders inBasgiathto leave to help manage this crisis. During these five days while Violet had been under interrogation, Xaden managed to also round up all the marked ones who had graduated and other ones they trusted, likeHeatonandEmery. They arrive just in time to break Violet out of the interrogation chamber after she andDain Aetostook care ofVarrish. Garrick jokingly complains about Xaden not waiting for him and killing everyone, not leaving anything for him to do. Godsdamn, Garrick says from behind Xaden. You took off running and then couldnt save a single one for me? Took me forever to clear the barricade of bodies in the staircase. Garrick to Xaden,Iron Flame Garrick to Xaden,Iron Flame Xaden orders Garrick to clean the stairway and then to findBodhito "track down whatever antidote Violet and the rest of her squad need", but on the way he runs intoLilith Sorrengail, who threatens him by putting a blade to his throat. She doesn't try to stop them, just asking for a few moments to explain herself to Violet and to say goodbye. Xaden! Garrick calls out from the stairwell. We have a problem!What kind of problem, Garrick? Xaden asks as we round the corner of the staircase. A general-size one, Garrick answers, his hands in the air. They manage to convince the Assembly that the cadets are an advantage and that it is better to get them back to classes, also proving thatDain Aetosand the three scribes they brought along can be trusted. As a commissioned rider, Garrick, along with Xaden,Emery,HeatonandNyra Voldarenare "sent in shifts to man the outposts along the Cliffs of Dralor". They are also tasked with running the weapons to the front lines once they acquire the luminary fromTecarus. After the venin take Pavis, all first and second-year lieutenants are sent back to Aretia. Garrick,Heatonand Xaden are clearly demoralized at the realization that the venin are rapidly advancing and by the losses they suffered, likeNyra Voldarenwho met a similar death toSoleil Telery. Following the battle at Draithus, Xaden argues for the advantages of reorganizing the squads by strengths, since the active riders dont have a full wing to pull from, which ultimately comes to pass. His riot consists of ten dragons and their riders, including: Garrick, Heaton, Emery and Cianna. Upon returning from Draithus, Garrick mentions to Violet that Xaden had taken out a venin recently, to Xaden's irritation. The whole exchange points to a certain tension between the two of them as Imogen accuses Garrick of not being in the position to talk about stable relationships and Garrick boasts about his sex life. Just doing my part to help your communication skills thrive in a stable relationship. paragraphs: As everyone who left with Xaden for Athebyne was presumed dead, Command is forced to hand-write on the spot orders for the three third-years -Xaden Riorson, Garrick Tavis andMasen Sanborn.

There were no other choices by the time they were allowed to pick, but Garrick and Xaden somehow managed to get appointed to the same outpost, at Samara, the "easternmost outpost of the Southern Wing, where the borders of Krovla and Braevick provinces intersect".
Before they were allowed to leaveBasgiath War College, all the graduates who had a rebellion relic were thoroughly searched as Command started to suspect their smuggling operation.

Samara is described as one of the cruelest outposts there are in Navarre and both Xaden and Garrick have to prove themselves all over again, like in Basgiath.Xadenmentions during one of Violet's visits that Garrick received a somewhat warmer welcome at Samara compared to him, as his father was not the Great Betrayer, but that also came with the disadvantage that the other riders have no qualms sharing a bathroom with him, as they do with Xaden.
I think the last name does it more than the relic.
The older riders are easier on Garrick, which Im thankful for.

Xaden on Garrick's treatment at Samara,Iron Flame Xaden on Garrick's treatment at Samara,Iron Flame During another one ofViolet'svisits at Samara, an unscheduled one following some disturbing news about an attack on the outpost during which Xaden was said to have been injured, she walks in on Xaden and Garrick as they are sparring with their swords.

During said fight, Xaden teasingly lectures Garrick on being too slow and needing to get faster, before he "nails Garrick in the face with his elbow, sending him tumbling to the ground", thus ending the training session.

While at Samara, Garrick and Xaden continue the weapon smuggling operation, counting on Bodhi and Imogen sending the weapons from the forge at Basgiath through Violet asTairn'ssaddle is not checked byVarrishand his subordinates.
They have selected a location close to Athebyne to drop the shipments.
Figuring out that something is wrong when he doesn't hear from Violet, Xaden, along with Garrick, deserts and set off forBasgiath.

In order to create a diversion, they have allies drop wyvern carcasses to different outpost throughout Navarre to expose the truth aboutVeninsand forcing all the leaders inBasgiathto leave to help manage this crisis.
During these five days while Violet had been under interrogation, Xaden managed to also round up all the marked ones who had graduated and other ones they trusted, likeHeatonandEmery.
They arrive just in time to break Violet out of the interrogation chamber after she andDain Aetostook care ofVarrish.
Garrick jokingly complains about Xaden not waiting for him and killing everyone, not leaving anything for him to do.
Godsdamn, Garrick says from behind Xaden.
You took off running and then couldnt save a single one for me?
Took me forever to clear the barricade of bodies in the staircase.

She doesn't try to stop them, just asking for a few moments to explain herself to Violet and to say goodbye.

Physical Description.full_text: Garrick byLeah Croft Garrick is described as having pale skin, dark curly hair and hazel eyes. Violet notes that he has broad shoulders and a hulking frame, taking up twice as much space as average people. Compared to Xaden, Garrick is wider, more densely packed with muscle and his rebellion relic extends only up to his shoulder - the second largest, as far as we know. During the battle at Athebyne, Garrick also gained a six-inch scar that stretches from his temple to his jaw. Their voices are still muffled by the river, but I can hear the loudest of them, a tall, dark-haired man with pale skin, whose shoulders take up twice the space of any first-year, standing opposite Xadens position and wearing the rank of a third-year. The first description of Garrick Tavis,Fourth Wing, Chapter 7 The first description of Garrick Tavis,Fourth Wing, Chapter 7 Unlike Xaden, Garrick also likes to boast his fighting skills, wearing several parches in a neat line on the right side of his uniform, "proclaiming him Flames section leader as well as more than five patches advertising his skill with a multitude of weapons". He also likes to wear his double swords strapped to his back.

Personality.full_text: When he is first introduced, Garrick seems to be very serious and duty-oriented - he keeps track of the marked ones they have lost and cares enough about the others having a real chance at survival that he offers to train the struggling first-years. We also see that he tends to be more rational and observant, noticing how blamingViolet Sorrengailfor her mother's involvement in their parents' execution is similar to how Navarre punished them for the rebellion led by their families. He also picks up rather fast on Xaden's feelings for Violet - a subject he teasesXadenon mercilessly every chance he gets. However, Xaden describes Garrick as lacking in patienceand this is visible during Presentation when he gets easily irritated withLucafor asking questions in an annoying manner, but also in the scene after the Gauntlet trial when he is quickly angered byAmber Mavismeddling with issues concerning his section. He certainly doesn't shy away from a fight and is willing to resume to killing if the situation asks for it. Behind the serious exterior, Garrick has a great sense of humor, teasing Xaden on multiple occasions and cracking jokes even when he has a blade pressed to his throat. He is also highly supportive of Xaden's relationship with Violetand acts friendly around her after she saved them all during battle.

Xaden Riorson.full_text: Garrick has been Xaden's best friend since they were little as his father wasFen Riorson's aide and Xaden mentions that they used to spend every summer together inRiorson House. It is not mentioned where Garrick was sent to after the Apostasy, but it is clear that the two of them managed to maintain their friendship and Garrick remains one of the few people Xaden completely trusts and would do anything for, completely disregarding any rules: There's no rule in this godforsaken college that would keep me from saving Bodhi's, Garrick's, or Liam's life... Xaden's POV of Chapter 16,Fourth Wing, Bonus Content Xaden's POV of Chapter 16,Fourth Wing, Bonus Content It is clear that there is a deep level of respect between the two of them, as Xaden recognizes Garrick as his equal when it comes to fighting and they use their sparring sessions to blow off steam, they avoid inflicting grave injuries to the other - although Xaden notes that when his best friend teases him about Violet he doubts he would be able to hold back: "Don't finish that sentence when I'm in the mood to hit people." We're mutually assured destruction against each other, which makes us the perfect sparring partners, but I'm just aggravated enough to do some real damage to my best friend, despite the size he has on me. Xaden about Garrick, Xaden's POV of Chapter 9,Fourth Wing Xaden about Garrick, Xaden's POV of Chapter 9,Fourth Wing Garrick is one of the first people to notice that Xaden has a thing forViolet Sorrengailand teases his best friend mercilessly about it, but also encourages him to act on those feelings and "figure their shit out" when Violet is mad at him for the secrets he keeps. "You in the mood to spar with first-years?" Garrick asks, keeping pace with me once I'm a few steps from Second Squad, a smile tugging at his mouth. Imogen Cardulo.full_text: Imogen and Garrick byillustratinghan It is clear from their constant bickering and teasing that Garrick and Imogen are particularly close. It is not mentioned how long they have known each other or the extent of their relationship - although, based on the fact that Imogen is just as comfortable aroundRiorson Houseas Garrick and Bodhiare and that she is among the few people Xaden trusts, they might have known each other way before theApostasy. Xaden reveals inFourth Wingthat Imogen has a crush on Garrick and Violet notes on "the pure yearning she cant hide in her expression as she watches Xaden and Garrick" sparring shirtless, but it is not confirmed whether Garrick knows about her feelings or not. Xaden puts the two of them in charge of training the first year marked ones inFourth Wingand they are seen multiple times throughout the books as fighting side by side or getting paired together. Imogen Cardulo and Garrick Tavis bybatboys.art There is clearly a level of tension between the two of them as in almost every scene together they are arguing for a reason or another. During the secret meeting with all the marked ones in Basgiath, Garrick tries to convince Imogen that Violet should not be the target of their desire for revenge againstLilith Sorrengailand, later on, after the battle at Athebyne, they are seen arguing again on whether they should take Violet toAretiaor not - an argument that seems to continue during the whole flight and during which their standing on the matter switched at some point. Youre sure about this? Imogen asks.Stop fucking asking him that, Garrick snaps. He made his decision. Support him or get the fuck out, Imogen. Garrick arguing with Imogen,Fourth Wing Stop fucking asking him that, Garrick snaps. He made his decision. Support him or get the fuck out, Imogen. Garrick responds by making a joke about his sex life, which seems to infuriate the third year even more. Like you have any room to talk about stable relationships, Imogen counters from behind him, the squad formation obviously having broken to ready for the mission.Im going to skip the obvious pun to be made about plenty of mares in my stable. He flashes a grin, then turns and heads toward the path at the end of the valley. Seeing as Im no longer a cadet but a mature, responsible officer. She scoffs as he walks by. Violet Sorrengail.full_text: Unlike some of the other marked ones, Garrick didn't project his hatred forLilith Sorrengailon her daughter, aware that punishing Violet for her mother's actions wouldn't make them any different than the people who executed their parents. He doesn't have many interactions with Violet before she bonds Tairn, aside from defending her actions in front ofAmber Mavison the Gauntlet. AfterThreshing, once they understood that Xaden's life depends on Violet's safety, Garrick and the rest of the marked ones closest to theWingleaderbecome more concerned with the youngest Sorrengail and appear ready to protect her, but, aside fromLiam, none of them actually get to know her. It is only after the battle at Athebyne that Garrick comes to respect and act friendly with Violet, thankful that she saved all their lives. He also expresses his support for her relationship with Xaden, confident that she will join their cause and encouraging her and Xaden to fix their relationship. Hey, Sorrengail, Garrick says, but I cant peel my eyes from Xaden long enough to glance his way. Good job today.Thanks, Garrick, I respond, moving closer to Xaden. Gods, you two. Garrick shakes his head. Do us all a favor and figure your shit out. Ill meet you at the flight field. He smacks Xadens shoulder and walks off. Before the events ofFourth Wing.full_text: During her pregnancy with Violet, she became very sick and nearly died as a result.She held a high rank in Navarre and hadColonel Aetosas her closest aide. Shortly after her vital role in capturing the leaders of the Tyrrish Rebellion, Lilith was stationed as an instructor at Basgiath before becoming commanding general of the school a year after the rebellion.As a high rank member in the leadership, she either discovered through unknown mean. The knowledge and truth about the existence of Venin(s) beyond their borders are indeed real. Additionally becoming informed that the Scribe Quadrant are responsible for maintaining the strict blindfold around Navarre and its citizens in a cycle of ignorant for the sake of self-preservation. As a mother herself, Lilith did not approve the leaderships decision to make the Tyrrish children watch their parents be executed for their rebellion, an act she found cruel. After her husband's death, she told Violet six months prior to conscription day, that she would be entering theRiders Quadrantinstead of theScribe Quadrant.As she didnt want General Markham, who is the head of the Scribe Quadrant to manipulate and exploit her daughter. Moreover Lilith was concerned about Violet's response and reaction to the propagandised knowledge and lies about the Tyrrish rebellion and its origin. As a final consideration, she might have also wanted to ensure Violets survival in the Riders Quadrant. This thus resulted in Lilith making use of the favor that Xaden owed her from their mutual deal to keep Violet alive - no matter the cost. This agreement was necessary, as it was clear from the number of marked ones inside the quadrant that Violet would be killed. Violet's death would have been considered one of revenge, and part of the price to be paid for Lilith's involvement as General during the Tyrrish rebellion. At some point, Lilith found strange movements within the Basgiath forge where some of their weaponry supplies would often go missing, figuring it out it was actually Xaden behind all of it but decided to keep it to herself and let things unfold to prepare to for what was coming .
