Fourth Wing.full_text: On conscription day, Lilith and Mira have a heated discussion about Lilith wanting Violet to join the Riders Quadrant instead of the Scribe's Quadrant. Lilith despite the argument and seeing that Violet even struggles with her backpack, still wants her to join the Riders Quadrant. She curses the illness she had during Violets pregnancy, stating that it has cost Violet all her color and power. She proceeds with telling her youngest daughter, that she will not watch one of her children join the Scribe. When Mira asks her mother, if she is desperate to lose another child, Lilith stares down on her and says that when Mira does not leave, she will have to face disciplinary consequences for leaving her post. She tells her daughter that she will not be able to interact with her, because of her rank as Commander of Basgiath and General. She tells her daughter that life will be harder for her in the Quadrant, because she is her mother and they want to test her. She says a cold farewell to her youngest daughter, telling her that they will see each other duringThreshingagain and that she expects her to be a Cadet at sunset. Lilith together withGeneral Melgren,Commandant Panchekand more than a dozen high ranking military members is present during Threshing. When Violet and Tairn arrive, she stares at Tairn without even looking at Violet. Her only interest seems to be to evaluate if Violets physical incapability will boost her position or if Violets dragon binding will be something bad for her. She even goes as far as telling Panchek to not say out Tairn's name loud, until Violet does it.She later gives a speech to all new bounded riders and the second and third years. She ends her speech with welcoming the newly bounded to a family that knows no borders and which is everlasting. She tells the newly bounded to step forward and ends her speech with addressing the dragons and saying it is an honor, as always. Five months after Threshing she meets her daughter Violet again at Basgiath, but is distant towards her. She does not seem happy with Violet, who has problems with channeling and did not manifest a signet yet. As well she is not pleased when Violet tells her thatAndarnawill not be available for research on feathertails. At last she tells Violet that she disagrees withXaden Riorsonbeing Violet and says Violet has big steps to fill. Lilith is present at the celebrations over the victory of theTyrrish Rebellionat Basgiath. She accompaniesKing Tauriand General Melgren and meets there Violet andLiam Mairi. She tells her daughter not to be so shy about the power she possesses, but is again not pleased with Violet saying Xaden is not causing any trouble. Without saying a proper goodbye to her daughter she tells the King thatDain Aetosis near them and that it would be a honor for him to meet the King.

Iron Flame.full_text: Lilith is present at the final formation of the year and the graduation. She is proud of her daughter for being alive, but shows this only for a moment before becoming again distanced towards Violet. She asks Colonel Aetos why Violet and all other members of the group which flew toRessonwere reported for the death roll. She further demands to know what Aetos ordered Xaden to do. When Xaden tells her that Violet nearly died, she again shows feelings towards her daughter and sees her as her child, not some random cadet. Furthermore she wants to know from Violet what happened and tells Colonel Aetos that he should never accuse a Sorrengail of lying. Lilith seems a bit shocked when she is told thatAthebynewas abandoned and becomes furious at Aetos when she learns from him and her dragon that he ordered it. She tells him that he lacks common sense and that she awaits him in her office. Lilith at last asks Violet if she survived a knife wound in her Rookie year, at which Violet answers with yes. Lilith tells Violet that she may have more of herself in her than she thought she had, before leaving without another word. Lilith was stationed at Calldyr for an entire week, When sudden numbers of Wyvern carcasses have been dropped to certain Navarre outposts, Lilith and the other leadership immediately flew off to handle the crisis. As she flew back to Basgiath to only find a dozen numbers of fresh corposes left behind by Xaden, she went down towards the Interrogation section only to find Garrick in her path and held him at knife point in his throat. She is the. horried to see Violet brutally injured from the torture she endured from Varrish for days. Which Violet remarks it was the only time she seen her worried and let alone called her name since the paraphet. Lilith asked Xaden of whom the latter killed, which he answered unapologetically Everyone, she only nodded and let Garrick go, while genuinely telling Violet that she did not know about what is happening or about what was Varrish was doing to her and claimed if she knew she would have come sooner. Lilith asked to speak to her youngest daughter one last time, Xaden refused which Lilith fiercely answered: You of all people know the lengths Ill go to in order to protect her. And since Im pretty sure youre the reason were getting reports of dragons dropping wyvern carcasses at every outpost we have along our border, the reason this college is emptying itself of most of the leadership in a rush to contain the problem, the least you can do is give me a chance to say goodbye to her Xaden only accused her of letting Violet get harmed under her watch which Lilith demand just only 3 minutes with Violet before they leave, Xaden refuse but Violet accepted her mothers offer instead. As she helped Violet walked the stairs, the latter spitely called her out for knowing the truth all along about the venin, Lilith answered: When you have children, we can discuss the risks you'll take, the lies you'll be willing to tell in order to keep them safe." She also includes about her secret deal with Xaden and the regrets that her plan almost cause Violets life which the effort would have been for nothing. Later when Brennan goes to Basgiath to aid with the wards, she sees him again. She looks at Brennan as if he's an hallucination, though Brennan remained cold to her as he still believed for years that she was willing to sacrifice him as a pawn years ago for a lie that the Navarre leadership was hiding against the Venin. Halden claimed he only cheated because he was grieving for his twin brother Alic,who had been killed atXadens,Garricks, and Alics first year atBasgiathduringThreshing.
About three years later, Halden unexpectedly arrived at Violets second-yearsignetsparring training, run by newly minted Professor Xaden.
Halden was still unaware of Xadens direct involvement, which caused Violet extreme trepidation at the potential confrontation with Xaden.

Halden was also interested in restarting a relationship with Violet, despite knowledge of Violets relationship with Xadenand Violets later observations of obvious extra closeness with his guard,Captain Anna Winshire.

Before Basgiath.full_text: Imogen is one of the children of leaders of the rebellion led byFen Riorson. She was around the age of 16 when she was marked with the rebellion relic and forced to watch the execution of her mother and older sister, both of whom took active roles in theTyrrish Rebellion. Fuck you. My daughter and I will meet Malek with clean consciences. Will you and your daughters be able to say the same when they come for you? The last words of Tracila Cardulo (Redacted),Onyx Storm, Chapter 63. The last words of Tracila Cardulo (Redacted),Onyx Storm, Chapter 63. According to both her andGarrick Tavis, General Sorrengail is responsible for capturing and killing all the leaders of the rebellion, including their families. Imogens head snaps in his direction. Her mother is responsible for the execution of my mom and sister. I should have done more than just snap her shoulder.Her mom is responsible for the capture of nearly all our parents, Garrick counters, folding his arms over his wide chest. Imogen andGarrick TavisaboutLilith Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Her mom is responsible for the capture of nearly all our parents, Garrick counters, folding his arms over his wide chest. Imogen andGarrick TavisaboutLilith Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Just like all the other 106 children of rebellion leaders, Imogen was given a protection stone made byColonel Mairiand she carried it with her throughoutthe conflict between Navarre and Tyrrendorand then as she was watching her mother and older sister's execution. The protection rune in the stone left dark whirring lines on the arms of all 107 children of the leaders of the rebellion, which would later on be referred to asRebellion Relicsand would lead to them being called "marked ones". Its a protection rune, but it was only intended to be used once. Each of the children of the officers were given them before our parents left for the Battle of Aretia. We were told to carry them at all times, and we did, even to the execution. It was designed to counter the signet of the rider whose dragon would kill them. He swallows. But it could only activate when killed by dragonfire. I kept it closed in my fist we all didas we stood there, watching our parents put into lines for execution. And the second they were... His shoulders rise as he takes a deep breath. ...burned, heat raced up my arm. The next time I felt anything like that was after Threshing. Second Year.full_text: Imogen is seen standing in formation on Conscription Day, her pink hair and rebellion relic catchingViolet Sorrengail's attention when she sees her new squadmates for the first time.Xadenmanages to move the whole squad under his chain of command, forcingDain Aetosto switch withAura Beinhaven- thus, Imogen is now part of Fourth Wing, Flame Section, Second Squad. The next morning, Imogen is mentioned as standing next to another second year with "hoop earrings in her left lobe", whom we later on learn isQuinn, after the death roll is read. Unlike Quinn, Imogen doesn't show any sign of amusement at Dain's joke about the high mortality rate in theRiders Quadrant. A few hours later, during the sparring class,Professor Emetteriocalls Imogen to the mat againstViolet Sorrengail. From the start, Imogen shows and expresses her distaste for the daughter of the woman she holds responsible for the death of her family. After Violet's comment abouther mother's involvement in ending theTyrrish rebellion, Imogen loses her temper and even uses her powers and tries to pull a blade on Violet. Saved by her dragon-scale armor, Violet walks out of that fight with a dislocated shoulder and a broken arm. Sorrengail. The pink-haired girl looks me over like Im something shes scraped off the side of her boot, narrowing her pale green eyes. You really should dye your hair if you dont want everyone to know who your mother is. Youre the only silverhaired freak in the quadrant.Never said I cared if everyone knows who my mother is. I circle the second-year on the mat. I am proud of her service to protect our kingdomfrom enemies both without and within. You bitch, she seethes. Your mother murdered my family. Imogen andViolet Sorrengailon Assessment Day ,Fourth Wing A few days after Assessment Day, Imogen is among the marked ones that meet near Iakobos River to discuss the situation of the struggling marked first years. She is assigned the task of training half of the new cadets, along withGarrick Tavis,asXadenconsiders her one of their best fighters (at a similar level with Garrick) and patient enough for this role. Garrick is our best fighter, but Imogen is right up there with him, and shes a hell of a lot more patient, Xaden notes, which is just ludicrous considering she didnt seem too patient while breaking my arm. So the four of you split yourselves up between the two of them for training. A group of three wont draw any unwanted attention. Xaden Riorsonabout Imogen,Fourth Wing Xaden Riorsonabout Imogen,Fourth Wing Towards the end of this secret meeting, one of the first years rises the issue of taking revenge onViolet Sorrengailand Imogen quickly jumps in to support the idea. ConsideringXaden's response, it was not the first time they discussed the problem andBodhimentions that Imogen's desire for revenge has already earned her a month of scrubbing dishes after dinner. Garrickand Imogen also argue on whether or notVioletshould be held accountable for her mother's sins before Xaden brings upBrennan Sorrengailas a reason why Violet would hate them as well, ending the debate by taking it upon himself to handle Violet. Yeah, Xaden, Imogen says sweetly, lifting her pale green eyes to him. When do we get to finally have our revenge?He turns just enough for me to see his profile and the scar that crosses his face as he narrows his eyes at Imogen. I told you already, the youngest Sorrengail is mine, and Ill handle her when the time is right. Hearing Violet snapping at Xaden loud enough for the whole Quadrant to hear, Imogen gasps and, according to Xaden, she was "no doubt worried that he'll lose his temper and kill the first-year"- which might point to Xaden having informed her about the terms of his deal withGeneral Sorrengailat some point prior to this as Imogen was decidedly all for killing the youngest Sorrengail. She is also seen teasing and mocking Violet after formation, right before theGauntlet, proving she hasn't forgiven the first year for the comment on Assessment Day. Good luck today. Imogen tucks an errant strand of pink hair behind her ear and aims a sickly-sweet smile right at me. Hopefully you wont fall...short. She stares at me with complete loathing for a second, then walks off with Quinn and Cianna, our executive officer, her shoulder-length blond curls bouncing. Imogen toViolet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Imogen toViolet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing After Violet bondsTairnandAndarna, Imogen joins Violet and her squad at breakfast (accompanied byQuinn,EmeryandHeaton) and explains them that afterThreshingthe power balance in the Quadrant shifts, along with the group dynamics, usingJack Barloweand all the cadets suddenly acting friendly towards Violet as an example. Noticing Violet's hesitation to eat anything now thatOren Seifertis on kitchen duty, Imogen gives her a part of her own breakfast - Tairn also attests to Imogen being trustworthy. Most likely at Xaden's request, Imogen informs Violet that they are to meet in the weight room to start working on strengthening the muscles around her joints. The morning after Threshing is always a clusterfuck. Power balance shifts, and you, little Sorrengail, are now about to be the most powerful rider in the quadrant. Anyone with common sense is going to be scared of you. Which is why youre now sitting with us? Rhiannon arches a brow at the second-year. Because I can count on one hand the number of nice words youve said to any of us. She holds up a fist with zero fingers raised. You werent interesting enough to sit with before, Imogen responds, then bites into a muffin. Imogen andRhiannon Matthias,Fourth Wing Which is why youre now sitting with us? Dain expresses his reluctance towards Imogen training Violet, but he is quickly dismissed by Imogen.Garrick Tavisis also present in the room, training one of the first year marked ones at the same time as Imogen trains Violet on a "machine with a polished wooden seat and two cushioned squares that meet in front of it at knee height". When Violet questions Imogen about Xaden being the reason behind the second-year's decision to train her, Imogen snaps at her and, with the kind of "fierce loyalty" Violet mistakenly assumes is motivated by a romantic connection, she makes it clear that Violet is in no position to question her about Xaden. Youre only doing this because Xaden is making you, right?Her eyes meet mine and narrow. Rule number one. Hes Riorson to you, first-year, and you never get to question me about him. Ever. Thats two rules. Im starting to think my first guess about them is right. With that kind of fierce loyalty, they have to be lovers. Thats two rules. Im starting to think my first guess about them is right. With that kind of fierce loyalty, they have to be lovers. Imogen andViolet SorrengailaboutXaden Riorson,Fourth Wing The members of the Second Squad seem to have taken up the habit of eating at the same table - except for the cadets their squad received after the disbanding of the Third Squad, who refuse "to sit with anyone with a rebellion relic", referring to Imogen. After Sawyer manifests his signet, Imogen and Quinn tell the first years about the risks of not manifesting a signet before the six month mark, On the nightXadenandGarricktrain together in the sparring gym, Imogen is also present (as the whole squad is preparing for the Squad Battles), "casually holding Ridoc in a headlock, waiting for him to tap out". Like nearly everyone in the room, Imogen also follows the sparring match between the marked third-years and Violet notes the "pure yearning" on her face, very similar to how Violet herself feels as she looks at Xaden, and mistakenly assumes that the two have a romantic relationship. Later on, on the Parapet, Xaden explains that they are just friends and that Imogen actually has a thing forGarrick. A repetitive smacking sound draws my attention to the right, where Ridoc is tapping out with zeal. Imogen drops him, leaving him gasping for breath on the mat, and an unwanted and absolutely illogical flash of ugly, twisted jealousy stabs me straight in the chest at the pure yearning she cant hide in her expression as she watches Xaden and Garrick. Imogen watching the sparring match,Fourth Wing Imogen watching the sparring match,Fourth Wing During the same sparring gym scene, whenJack Barlowethreatens Violet, Garrick,LiamandImogeninch closer in case they would have to intervene to protect her - arguably, not entirely because they care about her at that point, but because they care about Xaden. After the sparring trial of the Squad Battles, Imogen is seen taking part in the short moment of celebration along with the rest of the squad - Violet notes: "Im pretty sure I even see Imogen in this little melee"- right before they notice the absence of leadership in the room andCommandant Panchekinforms them about the last task. In the absence of theirSquadleader, Dain Aetos,and theirExecutive Officer, Cianna,Imogen steps up and takes command of their squad - althoughNadine, one of the first years transferred to their squad after Threshing, has a visible reluctance around marked ones.HeatonandEmerydefend Imogen's suitability for the role. As they discuss the plan to steal the map with information on all the outposts of Navarre fromGeneral Sorrengail's office, Imogen'ssignetis revealed as the ability to mind-wipe recent memories - just like Dain's, it is a classified signet as we learn inIron Flame. To recognize Violet's pivotal contribution, Imogen nudges her to present and take credit for the idea, which ultimately wins them a trip to Montserrat. As a reward for winning the Squad Games, Imogen's squad spends a few days in Montserrat. The cadets are divided into two groups - some spending the day withprofessor Deveraand then going on patrol, while the other half of the squad spends two hours flying around the surrounding area and then discussing battle strategy in the briefing room of the outpost. Imogen is not mentioned as part or either group and we learn from the Xaden POV of chapter 27 that, under the pretence that she is vomiting in the infirmary", she was sent on a secret weapon drop an hour south of Montserrat, towards the Braevick border, carrying two dozen daggers across the border. The mission is described by Xaden as "a calculated risk given that he hadn't had much time to get a message to Syrena and her drift", putting Imogen at risk of running into Cygnis fliers who "would take the daggers and then kill Imogen to make a point". Not that the healer will remember her ever being there, thanks to Imogen's handy little signet. If she's on schedule, she'll be on her way back from delivering the drop I brought with me. Imogen is also mentioned helping her team during the War Games. During the last challenge, she is part of the teamXaden Riorsonassembles to fly toAthebyne,along withGarrick Tavis,Bodhi Durran,Liam Mairi,Eya,Masen Sanborn,Soleil Telery,CiaranandViolet Sorrengail. It is obvious that she knows about theVeninsand has been part of the secret weapon smuggling as she, like the other marked ones on the team, is not surprised at the apparition ofgryphonfliers one day earlier than expected for the weapon shipment. After the gryphon fliers take off, Imogen leaves Violet and Xaden to sort out their issues, returning to the dragons along with the rest of their drift. Good luck, Riorson. Imogen tucks a piece of her pink hair behind her ear, her rebellion relic peeking out above the sleeve of her flight leathers as she turns to give us space. Imogen Cardulo after Violet learns about the venins,Fourth Wing Imogen Cardulo after Violet learns about the venins,Fourth Wing Upon arriving at the deserted Athebyne outpost, the group is divided to search for clues as to why such a strategically important outpost ("the post they do the yearly trades at" and where there are more than three hundred civilians) would be deserted. Imogen andGarrickare the ones to find the missive with instructions left byColonel Aetos. Learning that the whole village was left defenseless, Imogen is the first to state her intentions of fighting to defend the civilians when they are given the choice to run away to safety. Were riders, Imogen says as another explosion sounds. We defend the defenseless. Thats what we do. Imogen to Xaden,Fourth Wing Imogen to Xaden,Fourth Wing Before going into theBattle of Ressonto protect the civilians inRessonagainst the venin, Xaden gives everyone the chance to turn around and fly for Eltuvan where the rest of the Wing was sent for the War Games. The next morning, Imogen is mentioned as standing next to another second year with "hoop earrings in her left lobe", whom we later on learn isQuinn, after the death roll is read.

A few hours later, during the sparring class,Professor Emetteriocalls Imogen to the mat againstViolet Sorrengail.
From the start, Imogen shows and expresses her distaste for the daughter of the woman she holds responsible for the death of her family.
After Violet's comment abouther mother's involvement in ending theTyrrish rebellion, Imogen loses her temper and even uses her powers and tries to pull a blade on Violet.
Saved by her dragon-scale armor, Violet walks out of that fight with a dislocated shoulder and a broken arm.
Sorrengail.

You really should dye your hair if you dont want everyone to know who your mother is.

I circle the second-year on the mat.
I am proud of her service to protect our kingdomfrom enemies both without and within.

Your mother murdered my family.

So the four of you split yourselves up between the two of them for training.
A group of three wont draw any unwanted attention.

To recognize Violet's pivotal contribution, Imogen nudges her to present and take credit for the idea, which ultimately wins them a trip to Montserrat.
As a reward for winning the Squad Games, Imogen's squad spends a few days in Montserrat.

The cadets are divided into two groups - some spending the day withprofessor Deveraand then going on patrol, while the other half of the squad spends two hours flying around the surrounding area and then discussing battle strategy in the briefing room of the outpost.

Imogen is not mentioned as part or either group and we learn from the Xaden POV of chapter 27 that, under the pretence that she is vomiting in the infirmary", she was sent on a secret weapon drop an hour south of Montserrat, towards the Braevick border, carrying two dozen daggers across the border.

The mission is described by Xaden as "a calculated risk given that he hadn't had much time to get a message to Syrena and her drift", putting Imogen at risk of running into Cygnis fliers who "would take the daggers and then kill Imogen to make a point".
Not that the healer will remember her ever being there, thanks to Imogen's handy little signet.
If she's on schedule, she'll be on her way back from delivering the drop I brought with me.

Second year is the best, Quinn says, pouring ale from the pitcher into a pewter mug. Five days after Violet's fight with Dain, the cadets find pamphlets anonymously sent byProfessor Devera,informing them on how the province Zolya, the third largest city in the Braevick province, fell under blue fire dragons and their riders - venins.
Violet notices that both Imogen and Bodhi are shocked and visibly panicked at the news.

After Violet tells her friends about the venins and all the secrets she has been holding from them, Imogen is "more than a little short" with her during nightly workouts and she felt pressured to tellQuinnabout it all as well.

The Saturday after Threshing, Imogen, along withRidoc Gamlyn,Sawyer Henrick,Rhiannon Matthias,Bodhi Durran,QuinnandAaric Graycastle, joinsViolet SorrengailandXaden Riorson's plan to sneak into the Archives to steal the journals ofLyraofMorraineandWarrickofLuceras, members of theFirst Six.
She also joins Violet, Xaden, Aaric andJesinia Neilwartin breaking into the Royal Vault to retrieve the journals, her ability to wipe short-term memory making her their "last line of defense".
Before they leave the rest of the group, Imogen makes sure to use her signet on the sleeping guard, Nasya.

AsVioletand Aaric search for the journals in the Royal Vault of the Archives, Imogen asks Aaric if he is aware that by becoming a rider he forfeited his chances at being king one day - a role Aaric admits he has never been interested in.
He also admits to Imogen that he doesn't hate the marked ones - on the contrary, he admires them for following in their parents' footsteps and trying to do the right thing.
The only marked one Aaric hates is Xaden because he is the one responsible for his brother's death.
So, its not all marked ones you hate, she replies, folding her arms across her chest.Why would I hate you?
Aaric puts the tome back.
Your parents led a righteous rebellion, and from what I can tell, youre just trying to do the same.
I hate him for killing my brother.
Imogen and Aaric Tauri,Iron Flame, Chapter 23.

Once they return to safety, Imogen erases Nasya's memories again to make sure the guard doesn't remember whatever he might have seen when he woke up, beforeSawyerhit him from behind, rendering him unconscious.
They also learn thatQuinnsuccessfully projected into the commons to establish an alibi for herself,Violet,Rhiannonand Imogen, telling cadets that they were all drinking in Imogen's room.
On the way back to the quadrant, Imogen and Bodhi jokingly bicker about how 'uneventful' the evening has been for the two of them, teasing Xaden's overprotectiveness.
Well, that was blissfully uneventful.
Bodhi pushes open the door to the bridge.Speak for yourself, Imogen replies, smacking him in the chest as she walks by.
You werent in charge of keeping Xaden calm while Aaric had Violet trapped behind the wards with him.

The group disband, with Imogen and Quinn taking the stairs to their rooms, Bodhi and Sawyer heading to the commons and Xaden and Violet going towards the courtyard, where Violet is caught in the possession of one of the journals and taken for interrogation byVarrish.
After reports of Xaden deserting reach Basgiath, Varrish orders to have all the marked ones gathered.
When Xaden returns to Basgiath to rescue Violet and unveil the truth about the Venins, the wyverns and Navarre's lies, Imogen along with all the other marked ones and half of Basgiath flee to Aretia.

The next day after arriving back in Aretia, the Assembly calls for a meeting to discuss the sudden decision to turn Riorson House into a War College, holdingXaden Riorson,Violet Sorrengail,Bodhi Durran,Garrick Tavisand Imogen Cardulo responsible for exposing the truth and making such a decision "without so much as a vote from the council".
Here we fucking go, Imogen says under her breath.
Imogen Cardulo during the Assembly meeting,Iron Flame, Chapter 37.
Imogen Cardulo during the Assembly meeting,Iron Flame, Chapter 37.

As part of the deal withTecarusfor the luminary, the flier cadets are relocated to Aretia and Imogen, along with all the cadets who chose to come to Aretia, are "ordered to get a good nights sleep, pack for a three-day mission, and assemble for flight formation at four in the morning"before they accompany the fliers and their gryphons cross the steep, barely visible, narrow trail up the Cliffs of Dralor, while the dragons fly patrol above them, some of them carrying wagons, crossbolts and weapons (and complaining about being treated like packhorses).
Violets estimates that it would be twelve hours of constant climbing.
What the hell does he expect us to do besides climb with them?
Aaric asks, keeping his voice down.Catch them if they fall off?
Ridoc suggests.Right, because were capable of catching a gryphon, Imogen remarks.

Have to give it to the girl.
Imogen shakes her head, sighing as she looks past me toward Cat and her drift.
Shes tenacious.Every head swivels in her direction.
Hey.

Im Team Violet.

During the second year's rune lesson withTrissa, they learn that the marked ones already know how to do simple rune work.

Two weeks after the flies come to Aretia, the tensions between them and the riders are still high, so the professors decide to give the riders and the fliers the occasion to solve this hostility by daring cadets of the same year for challenges on the mat, before each squad of riders would absorb one drift of fliers the next day.
Imogen is called to the mat by a third year fromCat's drift,Neve, and their match is called a draw byDevera.

Imogen glares at Cat across the mat when the flier challenges Violet, then gives her squadmate insight on Cat's fighting style, hinting to the fact that she has met Cat before enough times to know about her fighting techniques.
From what I remember, shes quick on the attack and wont leave you much time to react, so commit to your moves.
Dont hesitate, Imogen adds.

The next morning, after formation, Imogen is with the rest of her squad, equally angry that Cat's drift has been assigned to their squad.
Imogen is also "laughing so hard she snorts"when Violet tauntsCatby mentioning the sex technique Cat said she taught Xaden.

After Violet figures out that raising the wards requires six dragons instead of six riders, the squad meets inRaegan Matthias's new house in Aretia for the second time that week in an attempt to alleviate the tensions between the riders and the fliers outside the academic setting of Riorson House.
Imogen comments on the 'struggle' of getting to know the new additions to their squad - the six first years and the six fliers - before making her way to save Quinn from Cat.

When Violet breaks the news about raising the wards in Aretia, angering the fliers at the prospect of losing their ability to channel, Imogen and Quinn flank Cat, making sure she doesn't attack Violet in her anger.

Imogen also steps in to highlight the importance of the wards in Aretia: Were no good to our people if we cant channel, Maren says, looking past Aaric to the window and drumming her fingers on the table.Yeah, well youre no good to them if youre dead, either, Imogen counters, keeping an eye on Cat.

They all insist that their squad will remain intact this time, unlike War Games when they were separated.
Upon reaching Basgiath,Sawyer Henrickand Imogen are ordered to stand guard at the opening of the tunnel to the wardstone.
When the available riders are divided into groups, the Iron Squad remain together andXaden Riorsonis assigned to their group as well.
This leads to Imogen,Sawyer HenrickandRidoc Gamlynmaking fun of the situation and their odds at surviving.

We get both of you?

As the child of a separatist, she carries the rebellion relic - a set of dark, winding lines that cover most of her left arm. Violet also notes that Imogen is about a head taller than herselfand has a toned body, considering her the kind of woman "whose beauty is only outmatched by her brutality". Personality.full_text: Judging by the way she easily lost control during her fight with Violet on assessment day, it is safe to assume that Imogen is easily riled up and holds a grudge againstGeneral Sorrengail, whom she considers responsible for the execution of her mother and sister after the Apostasy. In the same fight, but also during other interactions with Violet, Imogen is vicious, ruthless and snarky. However, during the secret meeting scene, we get a glimpse of a whole different side of her - more open, almost caring around her friends and, seeing as she is one of the few people who talk during the meeting tasked with looking after the first years, it is safe to assume that she is respected and pretty high in the chain of command of the marked ones.Xadenalso notes that she is far more patient thanGarrick. We also see that Imogen is able to overcome her own feelings and prejudices, putting the well-being of herfriendand the duties she has within the rebellion above herself. She accepts to train Violet out of loyalty to Xaden and gradually warms up to her as she admits inIron Flame. It can also be noted that Imogen is fiercely loyal and protective of her friends in multiple scenes throughout the series. There is also a playful, mischievous side of Imogen as she doesn't pass on any opportunity to tease and challenge her friends or to make a sarcastic comment - see, for example her teasing Xaden during the secret meeting or Violet on the "love triangle" with Dain and Xaden, but also on her uncertain relationship status with Xaden throughoutIron Flame. She engages in discussions and jokes around withQuinn,Ridoc Gamlyn,Sawyer HenrickandBodhi Durranin multiple scenes. She is visibly uncomfortable talking about feelings and relationships with Violet and immediately shuts down the possibility of talking about her own romantic life with anyone but her best friend,Quinn. Can you love someone who refuses to be open with you? I challenge.One, she blatantly mimics me, were not talking about my love life. I have Quinnmy actual friendfor that. She pins back the longest section of her pink hair with quick, efficient movements. Two, we keep information classified all the time. Youd have the same problem with any rider you dated. You didnt want normal. If you did, youd be in a relationship with Aetos. She shudders. Or hell, anyone else in this place. But you wanted Riorson. If you didnt think the man was hiding more than a few battle-axes, then youre mad at the wrong person, because you lied to yourself. Oh, look, our time is up. She sighs in obvious relief. Xaden Riorson.full_text: As Xaden himself admits, him and Imogen are friendsand, considering the fact that he allows Imogen to step out of line, tease and joke around with him (something only few other marked ones are seen doing -Garrick Tavis,Bodhi Durran,Liam Mairi), it can be argued they are pretty close and there is a deep level of trust between the two of them. Like most of the marked ones, Imogen owes a life debt to Xaden for the deal he made with General Sorrengail in exchange for their lives. She is fiercely loyal and supportive of Xaden, showing she clearly trusts him. In turn, Xaden himself trusts Imogen - he asks her to train not only the marked first years that were struggling, but alsoViolet Sorrengailand he includes her in his plans. Xaden also trusts Imogen enough to allow her to not only know about the weapon smuggling operation, but to go on a weapon drop on her own while they are in Montserrat (a mission during which Xaden is worried for Imogen's wellbeing). After he graduates, Xaden leaves Imogen and Bodhi in charge of the secret operation and all the marked ones in the Quadrant, further highlighting the trust he has in the two of them. Thats a tough one, Imogen responds, turning to look at Xaden. Her profile in the moonlight is almost unrecognizable as the same person who shredded my shoulder. That Imogen is cruel, vicious even. But the way shes looking at Xaden softens her eyes, her mouth, her whole posture as she tucks a short strand of pink hair behind her ear. Imogen also teases Xaden on his relationship with Violet whenever she gets the chance. In turn, Xaden knows about Imogen's romantic feelings towardsGarrick Tavis- although it is unclear whether she told him or his second signet allowed him to pick up on her crush.

Quinn.full_text: Quinn is Imogen's squadmate and best friend in the Quadrant. The two of them have been in the same squad since their first year and, although we don't know much about their history, it is clear from their interactions that they are very close and trust each other deeply. For the first two years of their friendship, Imogen didn't tell Quinn about the weapon smuggling operation or about the truth Navarre kept from its citizens out of precaution and loyalty towards the other marked ones. Iron Flame.full_text: Jesinia is the first in her year. Violet is sure that Jesinia is trying for the adept path, which is the hardest of all degrees for scribes and the one every Curator of the Scribe Quadrant has to have. Violet asks Jesinia for books to begin researchingwards, but is unsure how much she can trust Jesinia and lies about the reason. Later, Jesinia seeks Violet out in the Riders Quadrant while Violet is on a run withImogento give her a book and ask for help. She asks Violet to help translate something fromOld Lucerish, and says she'll be in trouble for asking for help. They chat and then see a screaming second-year cadet being dragged off byMarkhamand two riders. Jesinia says she thinks it's her fault, because the rider requested a book the previous day, and she is required to keep of record of all requests. This reinforces the idea that Violet can't officially ask for certain books or topics. Later, Violet visits Jesinia in the Archives and mentions that the cadet they saw was executed. Jesinia said he had requested information about a battle that she could find no information on, and when she sent the request further to get help, he was taken. They talk about the folklore book Violet has, and how the Archives didn't have a copy. Jesinia says she has never recorded any of Violet's requests, and they talk more, Violet realizing that "she's catching on without me having to tell her." Jesinia says she will help Violet, but Violet is careful not to give away too much that would get Jesinia into trouble. Violet asks for books about theFirst Sixand the wards. They agree to meet up on Saturdays when it is quiet to make the exchange off the record. Jesinia says she has one request in return. The request is for Violet's copy ofThe Fables of the Barrens,which she willingly trades for a classified book about the First Six. They meet again that Saturday and Violet receives a book about the wards at Basgiath. Jesinia joins theRevolutionand goes toAretia, where she works to get a printing press running.

Physical Description.full_text: Jesinia has long brown hair covered by a cream tunic and hood with a golden rectangle on her shoulder. She is deaf and uses sign language to communicate with people.

Personality.full_text: As a scribe, she refrains from showing emotion. She has to smother her smiles. She doesn't enjoy violence and constantly asks Violet about her safety in the Riders Quadrant.Violet tells Liam that Jesinia is a long-term-relationship kind of girl and someone who plans for the future. While she appears stoic, Jesinia is rebellious and often breaks rules to help her friend, varying from small acts such as not recording Violet's request for The Fables of the Barren to joining the Revolution alongside the riders.

She doesn't enjoy violence and constantly asks Violet about her safety in the Riders Quadrant.Violet tells Liam that Jesinia is a long-term-relationship kind of girl and someone who plans for the future.

main.full_text: Liam Mairiwas ariderin the same year asViolet Sorrengail. He was fostered by the same family asXaden Riorsonafter their parents were killed for their active role in theTyrrish Rebellion.
paragraphs: Liam Mairiwas ariderin the same year asViolet Sorrengail.
He was fostered by the same family asXaden Riorsonafter their parents were killed for their active role in theTyrrish Rebellion.

Early Life.full_text: Liam was the son ofIsaac MairiandColonel Mairiand the older brother ofSloane Mairi. His mother was involved in theTyrrish Rebellionled byFen Riorson, her name being listed on the death roll of theCalldyrexecutions. Liam, like all other children of rebellion leaders, was given a protection rune crafted by his mother, which he held onto while witnessing the execution of the Tyrrish rebels, includingColonel Mairi. This gave him therebellion reliccovering his entire arm starting from his wrists. It remains uncertain what roleIsaac Mairiplayed in the rebellion, but he was executed later that day at their family's house according toViolet Sorrengail, his name does not appear on any of the official records on the Apostasy.Liam witnessed his execution sometime after the Calldyr executions. He was executed at our familys house. His features tighten. Before it was given to another noble, of course. And yes, I watched as they did it that time, too. I already had the rebellion relic by then, but the pain was the same. He looks away, his throat working. Then I was sent to Tirvainne to be fostered by Duke Lindell, the same as Riorson. My little sister was sent elsewhere. Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, Archives duty, Fourth Wing Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, Archives duty, Fourth Wing After the apostasy, the Mairi family's house was given to a noble loyal to Navarre and the Mairi siblings were separated, sent to different foster homes. Liam was sent to Tirvainne to be fostered by Duke Lindell, who also fosteredXaden Riorson. Xaden taught Liam to fight in preparation for when he would join the Riders Quadrant on Conscription Day.

Fourth Wing.full_text: As a child of a rebellion officer, he was forced to join the Riders Quadrant atBasgiath War College. He was initially assigned to Second Squad, Tail Section, Fourth Wing.He was the strongest cadet in Violet's year, having practically run across the parapet and destroyed every opponent during assessment day.He finishesthe gauntletwith the fastest time. During Threshing, Liam bonded a Red Dagger tail,Deigh. He was asked by Xaden to watch over Violet after an assassination attempt lead byAmber Mavis.Next morning after assassination attempt Liam accompanies Violet for Archives Duty where Violet observes the outright hostility towards Liam from other scribes. Liam mentioned that him and Xaden were fostered together catching Violet by surprise. Liam also bought up that he had to watch his father Issac Mairi burn at his family house whilst holding the rune, feeling the burning pain in his arm for a second time. "What did u want to be when you grew up?" I ask just to keep the conversation going."Alive." He shrugs. Liam and Violet Sorrengail on Archives Duty, Fourth Wing "Alive." He shrugs. Liam and Violet Sorrengail on Archives Duty, Fourth Wing The next day Liam is accompanying the squad to battle brief where he's busy working on his wooden dragon figurine. He notices Violet flipping Xaden off and finds it amusing. He teases Violet and makes a cheeky remark by stating he would be glad to review a few potential candidates for Violet if that would stop her from pissing Xaden off. He's playfully questioned byRhiannonwho is curious to know his rating methods. And now he's glaring. Tell me, is it fun pissing off the most powerful rider in the quadrant? Liam to Violet, Fourth Wing Liam to Violet, Fourth Wing During battle brief Liam and Violet are both confused as to why the, scroll they sneakily read during the Archives duty, was not being currently discussed. Sometime during December Liam is seen accompanying Violet and Rhiannon to the sparring gym carving yet another dragon figure. He is seen teasing Violet and Rhiannon who are busy watching Xaden and Garrik spar. He then proceeds to threatenJack Barlowewho is mocking Violet daunting her to hide behind Liam. Both Xaden and Liam later kick Jack out of gym. Later the same night Liam is seen having an awkward encounter with Violet whenTairneanachstarted channeling his powers. He questions Violet's odd behavior, Violet assures him that everything's okay and heads for his room. In the last week of January, we see Liam and Violet on library duty, where Violet requests him to keep a secret from Xaden. Liam panics when he learns about her upcoming challenge againstJack Barlowe. He is in denial stating that leadership cannot allow that to happen. He then suggests that they should let Xaden know immediately so that he can put a stop to it, but Violet beats him to it assuring that she can hold her own. Liam clearly expresses his dislike and states that he is against this idea but agrees to keep her secret because they're friends. When the challenge starts Liam begs Violet to let Xaden know and sprints towards third years for the Wingleader. "Tell me I can break the promise" Liam begs, and the pleading look and the in his eyes tells me exactly what a shitty position I have put him in."The third years are off doing third year things", I tell him as my toes touch the mat. " You can't get him here in time, but I know what it means to you to keep your word. Especially with him. Go ahead."He looks from me to Ridoc,"Guard her like you're me." "You mean I'm six inches taller built like a bull?", Ridoc gives him a thumbs up. "Sure. I'll do my best. In the meantime you'd better run. Liam's gaze finds mine, "Stay alive." Liam Mairi, Violet Sorrengail andRidoc Gamlyn, sparring gym, Fourth Wing He looks from me to Ridoc,"Guard her like you're me." "You mean I'm six inches taller built like a bull?", Ridoc gives him a thumbs up. "Sure. I'll do my best. In the meantime you'd better run. Liam's gaze finds mine, "Stay alive." Liam Mairi, Violet Sorrengail andRidoc Gamlyn, sparring gym, Fourth Wing Liam is seen sparring with Mikael, a rider from Second Wing during the last challenge of squad battle. Liam defeats Mikael and their squad jumps from 7th position to the third rank. His entire squad is rejoicing in glee congratulating him on his victory. He is then accompanying his squad for the last portion of the squad battle, using his farsightedness to help them win the challenge. The squad is sent to Mosterrat after winning the previous challenge. During training in Monsterrat Liam enjoyed actively pointing out to Dain, that Xaden, being present there due to his bond with Sorrengail was in charge and responsible for calling the shorts instead of him. One of the riders down the table whistles low. "Do you boys just want to whip it out and measure? It would be faster." Squad in Monsterrat, Fourth Wing Squad in Monsterrat, Fourth Wing During an afternoon in May, Liam is exitedly discussing about the upcoming war games, stating that an equally exited Deigh cannot wait to get back atGlane. During the battleBaideis seen attacking Deigh, trying to slash him with her scorpiantail. Liam is wounded when Jack jumps on his dragon and stabs him with his sword. He loses his footing and is falling off his dragon's back when he's rescued by Violet, manifesting her signet and using Andarna's power to save him Tairneanach roars with the unmistakable sound of pride." Lighning Wielder. " Tairneanach and Violet, Fourth Wing " Lighning Wielder. " Tairneanach and Violet, Fourth Wing Liam is seen accompanying his squad during the reunification day. He sticks to Violet's side even during this day stating his concern over her safety. Violet insists on him leaving when Tauri approaches the duo but Liam stubbornly refuses, insisting on staying by her side. She notes his discomfort when the loyalty of marked ones is questioned by the Generals. Go, I hiss at Liam in a whisper, forcing a smile for my mothers sake asGeneral Melgren joins them. Melgren may be brilliant, but hes also unnerving as fuck to be around. When your greatest danger approaches? I think not. His spine straightens Liam to Violet, Reunification Day, Fourth Wing Liam to Violet, Reunification Day, Fourth Wing Violet is absolutely furious thinking that Xaden forced Liam to accompany her during this day, but Liam surprisingly adds that he wanted to be there for her on his own accord. Dain allows them to sneak away for the evening. Once in the building, Liam is shooed away by Violet who states that she wants to go find Xaden Liam, you know I adore you, right?Well, thats nice Go away. I walk straight ahead through the courtyard. What? Liam catches up to me. I cant just leave you out here by yourself. No offense, I mean, your aim is shit according to you, but I get the rest! he calls out, falling behind. Liam and Violet during Reunification Day, Fourth Wing Liam and Violet during Reunification Day, Fourth Wing During war games, Liam joins Violet and Imogen, when their wing is taken to Athebyne. Liam is seen agitated and nervous during their time. A worried Liam questions Violet if everything's okay between her and Xaden, he insists that Xaden has his "priorities". When the fliers spot them around the trade post, Violet is shocked and ready to kill them but is restricted by Liam who keeps apologizing. Tairneanach roars, threatening him to step back. Were we ever really friends?I whisper at Liam, searching for the strength to yell. We are friends, Violet, but I owe him everything, Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, War games, before reaching Athebyne, Fouth Wing Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, War games, before reaching Athebyne, Fouth Wing Liam is miserable, begging Violet to trust his foster brother, but she lashes out at him pushing him away. When they reach the outpost, he confirms the presence of venins using his powers. He, alongside everyone, makes the descision to fight atResson. We watched as our parentswere executed because they had the courage to do the right thing. Id like to think my death would be just as honorable. Liam Mairi, during the battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam Mairi, during the battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam bravely fights during the battle, ushering townspeople to safety alongside Soleil. He and his dragon are locked in a tense battle with a venin wyvern, where Liam is seen jumping on to the wyvern and killing the venin with quick precision. Amidst the battle, Deigh jumps between a wyvern and Tairneanach, saving him from the beast's jaws. Liam is about to fall, when Violet grabs him pulling him on Tairneanach's back. Liam is in pain as the wyvern tears Deigh apart. Violet, anxiously questions his move to which he replies that he's her friend and is greatful for Violet saving his life. Why did you do that? I cry, my fingers searching for purchase on hisleathers to pull him closer. His gaze collides with mine. That thing was going to take a chunk out of Tairneanach. Youve saved my life and now its my turn. No matter what you think of me for keeping secrets, were friends, Violet. Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Tairneanach tries his best to get the wyvern of Deigh, but the creature stubbornly holds onto him wounding him deeper with its talons. Liam screams in agony for his dragon. Deigh and wyvern both crash to the hillside, where he doesn't move again. Liam screams, mourning for his dragon. Liam is in utter shock and pain, desperate to take his final breaths next to his fallen dragon. He stubbles forward before reaching his dragon, too weakened in his state. He tries comforting Violet who is begging him to stay. During his final moments, he begs Violet to look after his sister, begs her to forgive Xaden and hear him out. Thank you, Liam. Thank youfor being my shadow. Thank you for being my friend. He blurs in my vision as the tears come faster. Its been. My honor. Liams chest rattles as his lungs struggle. Liam Mairi in his final moments, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam Mairi in his final moments, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Xaden carries Liam to his dragon, honoring his final wish. Short on time, he tells Xaden that Violet is the one who can kill all the venin and Xaden should be the one holding them off. I dont need to ask. Liam is gone. Violet Sorrengail, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing After the battle, Xaden wrecked with guilt. He's seen struggling with grief while waiting for an injured Violet to heal as well as mourning Liam. Liam died protecting Violet, staying true to his friendship and loyal to his foster brother until the very end. Liam. Guilt pairs with soul-sucking grief, and I can barely inhale aroundthe pain in my chest. Id ordered my foster brother to keep her safe, and that order got him killed. His death is on me. Xaden Riorson, Xaden POV, Fourth Wing Xaden Riorson, Xaden POV, Fourth Wing

I cant just leave you out here by yourself.
No offense, I mean, your aim is shit according to you, but I get the rest!
he calls out, falling behind.
Liam and Violet during Reunification Day, Fourth Wing Liam and Violet during Reunification Day, Fourth Wing During war games, Liam joins Violet and Imogen, when their wing is taken to Athebyne.
Liam is seen agitated and nervous during their time.
A worried Liam questions Violet if everything's okay between her and Xaden, he insists that Xaden has his "priorities".
When the fliers spot them around the trade post, Violet is shocked and ready to kill them but is restricted by Liam who keeps apologizing.
Tairneanach roars, threatening him to step back.
Were we ever really friends?I whisper at Liam, searching for the strength to yell.

We are friends, Violet, but I owe him everything, Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, War games, before reaching Athebyne, Fouth Wing Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, War games, before reaching Athebyne, Fouth Wing Liam is miserable, begging Violet to trust his foster brother, but she lashes out at him pushing him away.
When they reach the outpost, he confirms the presence of venins using his powers.
He, alongside everyone, makes the descision to fight atResson.
We watched as our parentswere executed because they had the courage to do the right thing.
Id like to think my death would be just as honorable.
Liam Mairi, during the battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam Mairi, during the battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam bravely fights during the battle, ushering townspeople to safety alongside Soleil.
He and his dragon are locked in a tense battle with a venin wyvern, where Liam is seen jumping on to the wyvern and killing the venin with quick precision.
Amidst the battle, Deigh jumps between a wyvern and Tairneanach, saving him from the beast's jaws.
Liam is about to fall, when Violet grabs him pulling him on Tairneanach's back.
Liam is in pain as the wyvern tears Deigh apart.
Violet, anxiously questions his move to which he replies that he's her friend and is greatful for Violet saving his life.
Why did you do that?
I cry, my fingers searching for purchase on hisleathers to pull him closer.
His gaze collides with mine.
That thing was going to take a chunk out of Tairneanach.
Youve saved my life and now its my turn.
No matter what you think of me for keeping secrets, were friends, Violet.

Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam Mairi and Violet Sorrengail, battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Tairneanach tries his best to get the wyvern of Deigh, but the creature stubbornly holds onto him wounding him deeper with its talons.
Liam screams in agony for his dragon.
Deigh and wyvern both crash to the hillside, where he doesn't move again.
Liam screams, mourning for his dragon.
Liam is in utter shock and pain, desperate to take his final breaths next to his fallen dragon.
He stubbles forward before reaching his dragon, too weakened in his state.
He tries comforting Violet who is begging him to stay.
During his final moments, he begs Violet to look after his sister, begs her to forgive Xaden and hear him out.
Thank you, Liam.
Thank youfor being my shadow.
Thank you for being my friend.
He blurs in my vision as the tears come faster.
Its been.
My honor.
Liams chest rattles as his lungs struggle.
Liam Mairi in his final moments, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Liam Mairi in his final moments, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Xaden carries Liam to his dragon, honoring his final wish.
Short on time, he tells Xaden that Violet is the one who can kill all the venin and Xaden should be the one holding them off.
I dont need to ask.
Liam is gone.
Violet Sorrengail, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail, Battle of Resson, Fourth Wing After the battle, Xaden wrecked with guilt.
He's seen struggling with grief while waiting for an injured Violet to heal as well as mourning Liam.
Liam died protecting Violet, staying true to his friendship and loyal to his foster brother until the very end.
Liam.
Guilt pairs with soul-sucking grief, and I can barely inhale aroundthe pain in my chest.
Id ordered my foster brother to keep her safe, and that order got him killed.
His death is on me.
Xaden Riorson, Xaden POV, Fourth Wing Xaden Riorson, Xaden POV, Fourth Wing

Personality.full_text: Liam was seen to have an easy-going personality. He was always seen smiling, thawing even the coldest of hearts with his smile. He was loyal to a fault regarding his cause and supported Xaden's mission until the end. He was fiercely protective of Violet but also believed in her abilities to defend herself. He had an amazing sense of humor as was seen teasing and snorting whenever Violet and Xaden were busy with their antics. Fiercely loyal, charming, and a good sense of humor, Liam is well liked by those around him. He is open and honest when asked personal questions about his past growing up as a Marked One. While he understands how others view him, he carries himself with dignity and keeps a positive attitude.

Early Life.full_text: Maren is originally from Draithus. She is a flier cadet who transferred fromCliffsbane Flight AcademytoAretiaafter the attack on Zoyla. She's in the same squad asCatriona Cordellaand they are best friends. Her Gryphon's name is Dajalair, Daja for short.
paragraphs: Maren is originally from Draithus.
She is a flier cadet who transferred fromCliffsbane Flight AcademytoAretiaafter the attack on Zoyla.
She's in the same squad asCatriona Cordellaand they are best friends.
Her Gryphon's name is Dajalair, Daja for short.

Iron Flame.full_text: Maren is paired withViolet Sorrengailas they hike up the Medaro Pass to reach Aretia. She explains to Violet that the fliers do not want to go to Aretia any more than the dragon riders want them there, but they are going because it is the best chance for survival for them and their people. During the hike, Maren tells Violet that all the fliers expectedXaden Riorsonto kidnap Violet after Threshing his first year and gift her to the fliers. She says she was disappointed for Cat when Xaden broke off the betrothal, but she wasn't rooting for the toxic relationship they had. After nearly being taken out by a boulder on their hike, Maren explains how the bonding process works for fliers: they try to jump on the back of a gryphon as a group of them fly by over the river; no one dies, if they miss, they just choose a different branch for service. Maren and her gryphon struggle to get enough oxygen as they get close to the top of the cliff. She still manages to teaseDain Aetosfor shortening Violet's estimate for the length of the sword hilt thatLuellawill use to help her pass a trap without triggering it. Maren encourages Luella as she attempts to cross.When Luella misses her target and ultimately falls over the edge of the cliff to her death, Maren defends Violet to Cat who accuses Violet of dropping Luella. She reminds Cat that Luella's gryphon doesn't have long since gryphons die with their fliers, and they offer the gryphon comfort in his last minutes. Maren gives Violet a leather strap to bite down on as Dain resets her arm that was dislocated as Luella fell over the cliff. Once the fliers have settled at Basgiath, Violet's squad and Cat's drift are paired together to learn runes. Maren is the only one in the drift who doesn't blame Violet for letting Luella fall to her death and Sawyer and Violet agree that they like her. Maren blocks Trager from responding toRhiannon Matthias' taunt. Maren is engaged in the rune lesson and wonders why no one teaches runes. Later, leadership encourages riders and fliers to challenge each other in sparring and Maren tries to talk Cat out of sparring with Violet.When Cat is caught using her powers on the mat, Maren and Bragen are ordered to escort her to her room.The next day, as Violet's squad absorbs Cat's drift, Maren chastises Cat for giving Violet a hard time, reminding her that Violet did not drop Luella.As the squad struggles to become a cohesive unit, Rhiannon assigns study partners, pairing up Maren and Violet. Cat carries with her a fire rune that Maren made and reveals that all the fliers make the runes they are best at and trade with each other so they all have what they need. When Violet warns the fliers that they won't be able to access magic from their gryphons once the wards are raised properly, Maren says they are no good to their people if they cannot channel.But later when Violet is in the library trying to figure out why the wards aren't fully functional, Maren, along with Cat and Trager, sits with her in a show of support. When the riders leave Aretia to defend Basgiath, Maren tells Violet that the gryphons are not happy about being left behind. She gives Violet a small crossbow with a quiver full of maorsite arrowheads, imbued and runed to explode on impact. She explains that it will be a secondary weapon in case Violet runs out of daggers and shows her how easy it is to operate. When the fliers join the riders at Basgiath, Maren bringsJesinia Neilwart, the scribe who is helping to figure out how to fix the wards. Later, Maren and Daja, along with Cat and Bragen, are helping to ferry the wounded away from the battle because the gryphons cannot fly in the heavy rain thatGeneral Sorrengailhas produced. She comforts Sawyer as they take him to the healers after a wyvern takes his leg.

Early Life.full_text: Mira grew up wanting to be a rider, and according to Violet, by the time Mira was twenty she had been training in hand-to-hand combat for twelve years.When she entered the Riders Quadrant, her brother Brennan gave her theBook of Brennanto help her survive in the quadrant. She went on to thrive in the quadrant, despite being targetted by other cadetsdue to her mother being General Sorrengail. Mira only ever gained one scar which she got from herdragon,Teine, duringThreshing. Prior to the events inFourth Wing, Mira earned the Order of the Talon for her role in the Battle of Strythemore. She was then sent to patrol the border with the Eastern Wing as Lieutenant in theNavarrian military.

Fourth Wing.full_text: Violet has not seen Mira in years when Mira arrives atBasgiath War Collegeon Conscription Day. Mira is furious with their mother for forcing Violet to enter the Riders Quadrant instead of theScribe Quadrantas Violet wanted. Mira gives Violet a custom-made vest made of her dragon Teine's scales, a pair of rider boots, and repacks Violet's bag to help her surviveParapetand theRider's Quadrant. Mira accompanies Violet to the base of the turret, giving verbal advice on potential allies,Dain Aetos, their childhood friend, and enemies,Xaden Riorson. After Violet survives Parapet, Mira is able to smuggle theBook of Brennanto her bunk which she used to survive the Quadrant herself. Stationed at Montserrat, when Fourth Wing wins the chance to visit an outpost, Violet and Mira reunite. Witnessing the strained relationships Violet is currently contending with regarding both Dain and Xaden, Mira gives advice to all 3 of them. A drift of gryphons attack the outpost, Mira mounts up to defend the outpost. This causes the students to end their trip early and flee despite Violet's protests.

Iron Flame.full_text: Mira writes to Violet,now that she is a second-year rider, that she has been reassigned to Athebyne. Any other details in the letter are redacted. Later, during one of Violet's visits to Xaden, Mira interrupts their kiss, having just been reassigned toSamarawhere Xaden has been since his graduation. Mira immediately recognizes Violet's feelings for Xaden and calls her out for them. The sisters discuss Xaden, RSC training, and wards all while Mira is unaware that Violet is keeping a secret from her. Violet tries to clue Mira in on the real threat to the continent, but Mira is oblivious to the suggested truth. After an attack at Samara, Mira is unharmed and tells Violet where to find Xaden who has now recovered from an injury. After Wyvern corpses are dropped at the outposts, Mira leads the riot of riders joining the revolution in Aretia from the front lines of Navarre. When she reunites with Violet, she apologizes for not realizing that Violet was telling her the truth at Samara. This is the first time Mira has seen Brennan since his reported death. Her response to the discovery was a swift, unapologetic punch to the facethus breaking his nose, and the two continued to bickeruntil Violet intervened.

Physical Description.full_text: Mira Sorrengail byLeah Croft Mira is described as a younger version of her mother. With warm brown eyes, she is tall with strong hands, and powerful muscles toned from years of sparring and hundreds of hours spent on the back of her dragon. She is especially known for her right hook. She practically glows with health and her golden-brown hair is sheared short for combat in the same style as her mother's.She survived all three years at Basgiath with only one scar. She is everything Violet doesn't see in herself.Professor Kaorilater describes Mira as shrewd and gifted in the seat when it comes to riding.

Personality.full_text: She carries herself with a sense of arrogance and unwavering conviction that she belongs in the sky. According to Violet, she often argues with their mother, which garners her respect in her mother's eyes. Mira has theirfather'slaughand warmth. Mira is vocal about her frequent affairs with other riders. Violet further describes Mira as shrewd, cunning, and a touch cruel. Mira is also fiercely loyal and protective of her siblings, especially Violet. She goes the extra mile for her, commissioning special rider boots and dragon-scale armor from her own dragon to protect her in the Riders Quadrant.

Lesser magic also allows Mira to place runes.

It is alluded at their reunion that it isn't the first time she's broken his nose. Violet Sorrengail.full_text: Violet and Mira grew up together, with Mira being overprotective over Violet and being against their mother's decision to sent her little sister to the Riders Quadrant. She makes sure that despite her disadvantages, she will stay safe, such as advising her to at least keep her hair braided for combat and to wear the vest-shaped corset made out of her dragon's scales, that is able to withstand knives and daggers. She tells Violet to stay away from Xaden, as he will try to kill her at any cost to avenge his family. Even after claiming Tairn and Andarna, Mira makes sure that Violet will be safe from any harm.

Iron Flame.full_text: Nadine was one of five surviving members of the Iron Squad at the end of their first year, out of the eleven cadets who had spent time with the squad.She drank with the other members of the squad the evening after graduation, agreeing withSawyer Henrickthat she was most looking forward to no more chore duty as a second year. She was decidedly more friendly toward Imogen that night and it gave Violet hope that the marked lieutenants might not face discrimination at their duty stations. She asked what it was like to see real action in theBattle of Resson, pushing harder than Violet was comfortable with, but Imogen answered her questions. She slipped and sprained her hand on the steps two nights beforeParapet.Nolon Colbersywas not available to mend it, so she had her hand braced and wrapped the next day, but was hoping to have it mended before Parapet. For Parapet at the beginning of their second year, Nadine was on the tower with Violet, Rhiannon, andDain Aetos, their wingleader, although she did not have a job and was only there because she was bored. The women discussed how nervous the cadets look and how nervous they had been before crossing themselves the year before. In the first formation after Parapet, Nadine stood withRidoc Gamlynand Violet behind the new first years in their squad. AfterSolasbreathed fire over them, she pointed out that Violet's back was scorched. At Assessment Day, Nadine acted like she wasViolet Sorrengailwhen a first year overheard the name, and was killed by the assassin trying to find Violet.

After several others tried to take Violet out, Oren grabbed her and began choking her, but before she lost consciousness, he replaced his hand with his dagger. Xaden responded that dragons don't make mistakes and used his shadows to choke to death every attacker except Oren. Biography.full_text: Professor Carr is the professor of wielding.He helps cadets learn how to nurture their signets, develop shields and master lesser magic. He is mentioned before he is introduced because Violet doesn't get to take his class until she starts channeling. He is first seen by Violet when he kills Jeremiah in public because the student's inntinnsic ability manifests. When she manifests her signet, Carr shows up at her door the next morning, saying that she needs to learn to wield quickly if she is making lightning strikes in her sleep. He takes her to a far off field to practice. He attempts to train Violet, though he does not have a lot of knowledge about lightning wielders. As they train, she notes he cares more about quantity of strikes as opposed to aim. In Iron Flame, he is there whenVarrishpunishes Violet for not bringingAndarnaby forcing Violet to near burnout. Carr ultimately sticks up for her, telling Varrish that her death, and Xaden's, would be a great loss to the war effort. Varrish still pushes, and she reaches the brink of burnout. Carr tells her how to calm the burnout and encourages her to bring Andarna next time to avoid Violet's own death, as well as Xaden's, Sgaeyl's, and Tairn's deaths.

Iron Flame.full_text: Professor Grady is new to teaching atBasgiath War College. He teaches Rider Survival Course (RSC), which is a second-year class kept secret from first-years. He explains to the cadets on their first day of class how they will learn how to survive if they are separated from their dragons behind enemy lines. He refuses to give specifics because they want the cadets to be surprised, but he promises to teach them navigation, survival techniques, and how to withstand interrogation. Grady introducesViolet Sorrengail's squad to their first land navigation exercise, handing them waterskins containing a liquid that cuts them off from their dragons and their power. He agrees whenRidoc Gamlyncalls the move bullshit, but he tells the cadets that they are very proud of this new concoction and asks them to let him know if they feel any side effects. Grady lectures the cadets frequently about their inability to check their egos. When Grady corners Violet for her first interrogation, he finds her withXaden Riorsonand notes that she is hard to catch by surprise, thanks to the wards on her room that he assumes Xaden must have woven for her. While all of the other members of Violet's squad have their hands bound behind their back, Grady has mercy on Violet's injured shoulder and binds her hands in front of her, though Violet notes that the rope is very tight. Grady introduces the cadets to their first interrogation scenario, but tricks them into thinking that the scenario hasn't begun yet when he brings in food and drink, encouraging them to partake since it will be their last chance until the interrogation is over. He tells them that there is a patch available if they are able to escape, though no one has succeeded in the past decade.The squad finds Grady sitting in a chair a few feet away from the door to the interrogation chamber when they escape, where he praises their success.

One day, during library duty,Jesinia Neilwartasks Violet to deliver a scroll to Markham, who left before his daily report arrived. When the scroll unintentionally unrolls, Violet catches a glimpse of news about an attack at Sumerton, but in Battle Brief that morning, Markham announces that the front lines are relatively quiet and discusses a historical battle instead.Markham is shocked when Violet presents the map her squad has stolen from the general's office for the final task of the Squad Battle, which depicts all current skirmishes, including those not discussed in Battle Brief. After Violet and her squad are forced to leaveMira Sorrengailand the other lieutenants when Montserrat is attacked by gryphons during their visit, Violet waits outside Markham's office in the Riders Quadrant for news of her sister. He first tells her that the information is classified and anything that can be shared will be discussed in Battle Brief. When she pushes for him to just tell her if Mira is alive, he confirms that no riders were lost at Montserrat.

Iron Flame.full_text: In the first Battle Brief of the year, Markham and Devera describe an attack on Athbyne which causes Violet to gasp. Markham asks if she has something to say and challenges her with a lift of his brow. She tells herself that he obviously knows what is going on beyond the borders, but she wonders if he knows that she knows about it too. Violet discovers that Markham hadNavil Jacekkilledfor requesting an account of a border attack that didn't exist. One day, Rhiannon Matthias arrives at Battle Brief with a notice her parents sent to her, warning not to take in strangers. Markham snatches the paper from Violet's hands as she looks at it and uses it to teach the class a lesson about propoganda. Violet feels that when he reads the notice aloud, he changes the meaning of the notice from a warning to a passionate plea. He goes on to discredit claims that dragons are destroying Poromish cities. Another day, Deverasecretly distributes a notice before Battle Brief headlined "ZOLYA FALLS TO DRAGONFIRE" and blames blue fire dragons and their riders. Violet and her squad debate whether the notice is real, but Violet notices Markham's tell as he rubs is forefinger against his thumb, indicating he had not planned for this news to be distributed. Following Violet's prediction, he discredits by collecting all of the notices and chastising the cadets for not being able to spot them as propaganda immediately, deflects by asking when Navarre has ever sent a riot of only blue dragons once no one has the notice in hand to note the nuance of the placement of the word fire, then distracts by announcing thatJack Barloweis alive after having by crushed by a mountain months earlier. Just after the notices about Zolya, Devera clues Violet in that Xaden was severely injured in an attack on Samara. Violet runs out of the class and Markham calls after her, reminding her that she does not have leave. Markham sounds the alarm when the royal wards within the king's private library are breached, leading to Violet's capture and subsequent torture byBurton Varrish.When Violet talks with her mother after escaping from torture,General Sorrengailexplains that she forced Violet into the Riders Quadrant because she knew Violet would never go along with continuing the complicated deception woven by the head of the scribes, a role Markham was training Violet for.

Iron Flame.full_text: Rhiannon is promoted to Squad Leader, asDain Aetosis moved up to Wingleader due to the graduation of the third-years. Violet, Rhiannon,Ridoc, and Sawyer are taken for interrogation training. They are each given classified information to protect during the weekend-long training. They are offered a patch if they manage to escape without breaking, which no squad has done in over a decade. Until the scenario begins, they are urged to eat and drink while sharing a secret that no one else knows. When they all lift their mugs to drink, Violet recognizes the smell of the elixir that severs the link to their dragons andsignets. They dispose of the liquid and agree to fake the disconnect when their interrogators arrive. For several hours, each of them is beaten for information, but no one breaks. Eventually,Varrish, who specializes in torture, arrives with Dain. Violet fears which memories Dain might take and deliver to Varrish, who is already suspicious of her andXaden. Varrish orders Dain to use his classified signet to pry information from Violets mind, but Dain refuses. Varrish decides to extend the interrogation another day and take the torture into his own hands. WhenNolonis brought in to heal them, he leaves the window to the torture chamber door unlocked. The squad works together to break out of the interrogation chamber. During a battle brief classViolethears news thatXadenandSgaeylhave been injured and between her emotions andTairnsshe leaves forSamarawithout approved leave. When she comes back Varrish is waiting for her and Rhi quietly sneaks a look at them through her cracked door. When Violet subtly nods at the alloy hinted dagger shes carrying, Rhiannon uses her signant to retrieve it through the wall, an impressive feat marking major growth in he powers. AfterVarrishand his cronies leave she pulls Violet into her room withRidocandSawyerand demands answers for whats been going on. Violet finally caves and decides that she trusts her team and tells them of theveninsecret and almost everything else. Rhiannon asks Violet what they can do about it, going into problem solving mode. She, Ridoc, and Sawyer all agree to help Violet in her research to find an answer to creating new wards. AtRiorson House, Rhiannon, Sawyer, and Ridoc help Violet, Dain, andJesiniago through the booksViscount Tecarusloaned Violet inCordyn.

During a battle brief classViolethears news thatXadenandSgaeylhave been injured and between her emotions andTairnsshe leaves forSamarawithout approved leave.
When she comes back Varrish is waiting for her and Rhi quietly sneaks a look at them through her cracked door.
When Violet subtly nods at the alloy hinted dagger shes carrying, Rhiannon uses her signant to retrieve it through the wall, an impressive feat marking major growth in he powers.
AfterVarrishand his cronies leave she pulls Violet into her room withRidocandSawyerand demands answers for whats been going on.
Violet finally caves and decides that she trusts her team and tells them of theveninsecret and almost everything else.
Rhiannon asks Violet what they can do about it, going into problem solving mode.
She, Ridoc, and Sawyer all agree to help Violet in her research to find an answer to creating new wards.
AtRiorson House, Rhiannon, Sawyer, and Ridoc help Violet, Dain, andJesiniago through the booksViscount Tecarusloaned Violet inCordyn.
