Physical Description.full_text: Rhiannon byLeah Croft Rhiannon's high cheekbones and oval face remind Violet of the beauty ofAmari, the queen of the gods. She has dark skin and brown eyes. Her dark brown hair is worn in several rows of short braids that just touch her neck. During sparring she often pins her braids back into a small bun at the nape of her neck.She wears a size eight shoe. The fighting leathers she wears on Assessment Day also consist of a leather vest similar to Violet's corset. However the difference is that Rhiannon's cuts in above her collarbone and secures at her neck, leaving her shoulders bare for movement.

Fourth Wing.full_text: Violetlearns Ridoc's name more quickly than the other first years in her squad because he cracks jokes throughout their first history lesson,and she describes him as a "smart-ass." Ridoc andAurelie Donansspar on Assessment Day, and Ridoc grumbles when he is forbidden from using blades byProfessor Emetterio. He is hesitant at first to properly attack her. His SquadleaderDain Aetostells him he's doing her a disservice by pulling his punches. He knocks one of her teeth out in the match. He makes everyone (evenJack Barlowe) laugh inProfessor Kaori's lesson about dragon kind when he quips if you offend a Red Scorpiontail, you'd be "lunch." Kaori also laughs and agrees with Ridoc that the best thing to do if you were to come across a Blue is to "run." The first time Second Squad sees the Gauntlet is also the first time Violet sees Ridoc "lose his temper or use anything but humour to diffuse a situation," when he snaps atTynan, who was sneering at Violet. Tynan tries to intimidate Ridoc, but it doesn't really work, seeing as Ridoc is twice as wide and half a foot taller. Tynan asks what his problem is, and Ridoc questions his loyalty to his squadmates. "My problem? You think because you made friends with Barlowe and Siefert that you have the right to be a dick to your own squadmate?" Ridoc GamlyntoTynan, defendingViolet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Ridoc GamlyntoTynan, defendingViolet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Ridoc snaps to Tynan "they're not timing us for presentation today, asshole," when he continues to call Violet a liability to the squad, butSawyer Henricksteps between them to break up their argument.Ridoc is the sixth member of their squad to attempt the Gauntlet, behindRhiannon Matthiasand beforeViolet.He mocks Tynan when the man hesitates on the buoy balls in the second ascent, and Violet reprimands him, saying that just because Tynan's a dick doesn't mean he has to be. "But he's giving me so much material to work with," Ridoc replies with a smirk. On Presentation DayHeatonwishes the first year cadets good luck, and Ridoc comments that he didn't realize the third year knew how to speak. He also notes as they file out of the courtyard that their squad is the biggest. WhenVioletmakes it to the top of the chimney, Ridoc cheers for her from the top of the Gauntlet. "Hell yes! That's our girl!" Ridoc Gamlyn cheering for Violet Sorrengail on the Gauntlet,Fourth Wing Ridoc Gamlyn cheering for Violet Sorrengail on the Gauntlet,Fourth Wing Ridoc andRhiannonboth hug Violet when she reaches the top of the Gauntlet, Ridoc hollering with happiness. Someone shouts that Violet can't do that (use her knife to climb the wall) and Ridoc defends her, saying "Yeah, well, she just did!" Lining up for Presentation, Senior WingleaderNyra Voldareninstructs them to "talk," and Ridoc jokes "nice day for a Presentation."Nyranarrows her eyes at him and explains she means to talk to each other to help the dragons get a sense of who they are. Ridoc is behind Violet on their return walk during Presentation, withLucafollowing him. He comments wonderingly about the dragons, "They're pretty incredible, aren't they?" Making Violet smile. When two Green dragons take an interest in Violet, Ridoc's eyes are wide as saucers, his mouth hanging open, and after the encounter he admits "I think I just shat myself."Lucasays she thought that they were going to eat Violet, and that she wouldn't have blamed them. Ridoc calls back "you're insufferable," but Luca continues to rant about Violet being a weak link. When a blast of heat hits Violet's back she's afraid that it's Ridoc who was killed, but we learn it was Luca when Ridoc mutters "Guess the dragons think she's insufferable too." On the morning of Threshing, Ridoc heaves up the contents of his stomach against a tree. Before separating to go into the forest alone, Ridoc orders the squad "Don't die." After Threshing,Violetleaves the healer's tent and is snatched off her feet by Ridoc, who yells "Look who rode in on the baddest motherfucker around!" He spins her around untilRhiannonchides him to put her down, pointing out that Violet is bleeding. Ridoc says "Oh shit, sorry," and releases her. He tells them proudly that he bonded a Brown Swordtail namedAotrom. Ridoc,Sawyer,Violet,andRhiannonare the only first years left in their squad after Threshing. Ridoc greets Violet and Rhiannon the next morning, slinging an arm around each of their shoulders calling them ladies, and then adding "or should I say,riders."They all agree being riders is better than being dead, and Ridoc pulls up the sleeve of his tunic to show them his brown dragon relic on his upper arm. He callsOren Seifertan asshole in a mutter, still angry that the cadet had tried to kill Violet during Threshing. Second squad all sit together at breakfast, and muse on it being weird that they are given a table immediately. They realizeJack Barloweis being iced out, and Ridoc comments "how the mighty have fallen." The third years from their squad also join them, and Ridoc callsEmery's air manipulation signet "epic," asking "how much air can you move?" Emery barely spares him a glance, answering that it's none of Ridoc's business. Violet reflects on the use of common magic to raise voices, and thinks "God help us when Ridoc figures out how to do that." It makes her smile, and she imagines he'll "find some way to annoy the shit out of every rider in the quadrant, not just his squad." At the formation after Violet is attacked by the unbonded cadets and a breach of Codex is called, the squad speculates who is in trouble.Rhiannonwhispers, "think Ridoc finally got caught inTyvon Varen's bed?" Ridoc responds that sleeping with him is hardly a breach of the Codex, despite the fact that he's the Executive Officer for Second Wing. He reminds them (without a touch of remorse) that it's not unlawful to fraternize with command, just frowned upon. He also makes it clear they aren't exclusive, and tells Violet if she's looking for a a little fun he's happy to oblige. "Fraternizing with command is frowned upon, not unlawful." Ridoc joins in saying "Oh, are we telling dick jokes now? Because my entire life has led up to this very moment." As per Dain's orders, Tuesday nights in December are for squad hand-to-hand practise.Liamrefuses to spar with Ridoc because he is Violet's shadow, and so Ridoc spars withImogeninstead - she holds him in a headlock asXadenandGarrickenter the gym and begin sparring, and doesn't release him until he taps out with zeal. Ridoc's signet manifests before Violet's in January - he is an ice wielder, which is described as a more common signet but "impressive to see." WhenJack Barlowechallenges Violet to a sparring match,Liaminstructs Ridoc to "guard her like you're me," while he runs to getXaden.Ridoc responds "You mean like I'm six inches taller and built like a bull?" He gives him the thumbs up and tells Liam sure, and that he'd better run. During the match, Ridoc supports Violet vehemently shouting whenJackattempts to use death blows and his powers against Violet. He attempts to come to her aid, but the power Jack is transferring to Violet makes both Riodc andEmetteriocry out and jerk back from touching them. He is also the first one at her side after the fight, instructing her to "breathe Sorrengail, just breathe." In March, Ridoc nearly dies from exposure when one of the new additions to Second Squad has their signet manifest during Battle Brief - another cadet also dies, freezing to death in seconds, but Ridoc is only treated for frostbite and has no permanent damage. For the last challenge of the Squad Battle, the squads are left without leadership to find something that "would be most advantageous to (their) enemies." Ridoc immediately throws his hand in the air whenImogenasks who wants to be in command of Second Squad.Rhiannonforces his hand back down, saying he'll turn it into some kind of prank. He shrugs and agrees. He suggests stealing a cross bow because it would be deadly to their enemies, and whenQuinnpoints out it would be too big, he offers "We could steal Panchek's underw-" but is cut off by Rhiannon, who says "and that's why we don't let you lead." In Montserrat (where the squad is sent for winning the Squad Battle), Ridoc asks "so all we do is wait for something to happen?" In the Battle Brief leading up to Reunification Day,Professor Deverareminds the cadets to wear "dress uniforms only," raising her eyes specifically at Ridoc. He shrugs and asks "what else would I be wearing?"Deveraresponds, "one never knows what you'll come up with." Ridoc competes in the War Games with the rest of Second Squad for Fourth Wing.

Iron Flame.full_text: Ridoc is one of the first peopleVioletruns into when she returns toBasgiathafter War Games and is holdingLiam's letters forSloane Mairi. She tellsXadenthat bothRhiannonand Ridoc can be trusted. When Ridoc realizes what she is holding he falls silent and says "shit." At Graduation, Ridoc whispers "it's kind of underwhelming," and says that surviving three years there should come with "a lifetime supply of ale and a party so good you can't remember it." During the party after graduation, Ridoc declares that the thing he's most looking forward to in Second Year is spending a few hours in Chantara each week - he then changes his answer to this question, saying that fraternizing with other quadrants is what he's most looking forward to.When Violet leaves to talk to Xaden, telling the squad she'll be back soon, Ridoc mutters "I certainly hope not, or you'll be destroying all my fantasies when it comes to that one." Learning that they'll be taking a new course called RSC in Second Year, Ridoc informsProfessor Gradythat no one wants his genuine reactions. "No one wants my genuine reactions" Ridoc Gamlyn to Professor Grady,Iron Flame Ridoc Gamlyn to Professor Grady,Iron Flame On Conscription Day at the first formation where cadets are sorted into Squads, Ridoc has his dark hair gelled into spikes. Standing in formation, Violet notices that he's got a new tattoo, and he proudly shows them the inked tip of a swordtail on the warm brown skin of his neck, telling them that it wraps all the way down his shoulder toAotrom's relic. He says "badass, right?" WhenSolasopens fire on the formations and burns most of Third Squad, Ridoc's spiked hair is flattened and singed, but he's otherwise unharmed. At first Ridoc argues that there's no way a secret that big could be kept, but he's convinced when the others point out how easily information is kept and controlled by what is published or not. While Rhi says she isn't pissed at Violet for not telling them the truth, Ridoc mutters, "I'm a little pissed." However, he's as steadfast as the rest of them when Rhi pulls Violet into a hug, resting his own hand on Violet's upper back and declaring that "the four of us stick together." "The four of us stick together. That's the deal. We make it to graduation, no matter what." The bad news is they need someone of royal blood to get them through them. WhenMira Sorrengailarrives inAretiaand immediately punches her brotherBrennanin the face, Violet shouts for ice, and when a guard appears with an icicle wrapped in a piece of cloth she thinks that she's never loved Ridoc's signet more. The riders are sent on a mission to hike up the Cliffs of Dralor along with the fliers and their gryphons. Violet has an idea before she jumps, and because Ridoc is the best climber they have, she gets him to scramble up the cliff and hammer his sword into the rock for the smaller riders and fliers to use as a handhold. He offers to catch Violet, who tells him to fuck off, and shouts "you've got this!" Holding out his arms before she jumps. She warns that she'll kick him in the face if he tries to catch her. UnfortunatelyLuella, a flier, doesn't make the jump - Violet yells for Ridoc to help her, only to turn and see him shot by two arrows that have pierced the side of his abdomen. He says he's all right as blood trickles from his mouth, and Violet screams for Brennan to save him. Violet insists thatDainputs her shoulder back in on the cliff so thatBrennancan mend Ridoc before attempting to help her. Brennan gets to work on him right away, but says he can't move him - when Ridoc tells them to leave him on the trail, Violet says "we made a deal, remember? All four of us live to see graduation. We. Made. A. Deal." Violet holds Ridoc's hand while she tries to figure out a plan, and then before she leaves to fight the wyvern she brushes the hair back off his forehead and says "You will not die. Do you understand?" He nods, his dark brown eyes fluttering shut.After Violet succeeds in killing the wyvern with lightning, she spotsRhiannonandSawyerbracing Ridoc between them, leading him toAotrom. He quickly says that he meant to say "Big." While the squad is hanging out after that, Ridoc tells Violet thatSawyerwants her to teach him how to sign, because he's not "fluent enough to make a good teacher, apparently." The squad flies back to Basgiath - insisting upon staying together - and go to check the wardstone, even thoughLilith Sorrengailsays that nothing is amiss. After Violet raises the wards again and the battle is over,Rhiannontells her that Ridoc survived, and is all right.

Physical Description.full_text: Ridoc has dark brown hair that flops against the brown skin of his forehead as he walks. Violet describes him as short.He's described as evenly matched against Aurelie due to his smaller size.However he's also described as being twice as wide, and half a foot taller, than his squadmate Tynan.After seven weeks of living in the Riders Quadrant Ridoc becomes less lean and gained more muscle.His dragon relic is of a brown dragon silhouette on his upper arm.At the start of his second year, Ridoc gets a tattoo of his dragon Aotrom. It ends near the base of his collar, and wraps to his shoulder where Aotrom's relic is.

Lesser Magic.full_text: As a rider whose dragon is channeling through them, Ridoc is capable of performing lesser magic. With this channeling, Ridoc is able to do things like locking and unlocking doors without touching them, moving with preternatural speed, manipulate mage lights, and power ink pens. Lesser magic also allows Ridoc to placerunes.

Early Life.full_text: Talia comes from the kingdom of Hedotis and worshipsHedeon, thegodof wisdom. At a young age, Talia entered a marriage contract withFen Riorson.The contract was to produce an heir for theNavarrianprovince ofTyrrendor. She had one son, Xaden, and was contractually obligated to stay with the family until he turned ten. She would make him snacks, such as sugared figs, and read him bedtime stories with arinmint tea; she would tell him stories of Hedotis, never revealing that it was where she came from. On Xaden's tenth birthday,March 621 AU, she baked him a chocolate cake and left in the night. Two years later, she is now married toFarisand they had their first son together,Simeon. They later have a second son,Gaius.

Onyx Storm.full_text: During the spring of 635 AU, she received news fromDeverellithat her son, Xaden, along with a crew ofdragonridersandgryphonfliers, would visit the island in search of information on the irids. She uses that time stocking up on chocolate and testing chocolate cake recipes to give to her son as an early birthday gift. DuringViolet Sorrengail'squest squadmission to theisles, they land on Hedotis. Talia comes to the beach with her husband,Faris, to greet them. She acts surprised to see her son, Xaden, among their squad.She hosts the squad in her home and bargains with Violet to give her a private audience with thetriumviratein exchange for getting Xaden to have dinner with her. Due to her shame, she asks her husband, Faris, to hold the triumvirate's test of wisdom privately in their home over dinner. During the dinner, she serves arinmint tea, gifted by Violet, and chocolate cake to make Xaden happy. The dinner takes a turn when it is revealed that her husbandpoisonedthe cake, causingGarrick Tavisto collapse.She then discovers that her and the triumvirate were poisoned by the arinmint tea and begins crying in the corner of the room. When Violet threatens her two youngest children, she pleads for Faris to do as she demands, to which he eventually abides.

Fourth Wing.full_text: Tynanwas a member of the same squad asViolet Sorrengail.During Assessment Day he was paired up againstRhiannon Matthiasand refused to yield untilProfessor Emetteriostepped in and yielded for him. At the squad's first gauntlet practice, he insinuated Violet should be weeded out because she is a weakling, causingRidoc Gamlynto lose his cool for the first time in front of the squad. Then Tynan froze on the buoy balls, shrieking as he started to slip off. When Rhi handed the rope to him, he used it to climb down. At Presentation, he picked on Violet, Pryor, and Andarna as they walked past the dragons. DuringThreshing, he joined withJack BarloweandOren Seifertin a plot to kill a small, golden Feathertaildragonin an effort to remove the weak. Violet stood in their way, protecting the dragon.She held off the three would-be assassins, hitting Tynan's thigh with a dagger, though receiving a cut along the length of her upper right arm,leaving a scar.Finally, while Violet was weakened,Tairneanacharrived, and Tynan made a run from the field, but the huge elder dragon incinerated him.

Biography.full_text: Not much is known about Ferris's life prior to the events of the series. Major Ulices Ferris is participating in the Assembly meeting whenViolet Sorrengailwakes up inRiorson HouseinAretiafollowing theBattle of Resson. He advocates for the cadets to be allowed to return toBasgiath. Later, after over a hundred cadets leave Basgiath due to leadership's cover-up of venins and the true nature of the conflict withPoromiel, Ferris implies that the only reason Violet is there is because ofXadenor that Violet is a double agent seeking to giveGeneral Melgreninformation about the Rebellion's location. He demands that Violet be confined and questioned, before being rebuked by Xaden who uses his authority as the head of Riorson House and seventh member of the Assembly to shut down the discussion. After the signing of the Second Aretia Accord, command of Tyrrendor's forces fall to the remaining houses, including Ferris andKylynn.Later, when Riorson House is attacked by Venin includingTheophanie, Ferris is away in Lewellen and unable to help defend it.

Early Life.full_text: BornJuly 613 AU, Violet is the youngest daughter ofGeneral Lilith SorrengailandLieutenant Colonel Asher Sorrengail, with two older siblings:BrennanandMira. Due to a fever her mother contracted while being pregnant, Violet was born with a rare condition, causing her ligaments and joints to subluxate frequently. When she was two years old, her father took her toUnnbrielto be dedicated toDunne, the goddess of war. This is perhaps when her hair started to grow in silver at the tips. However, an oracle said that Violet had multiple paths and could not be completely dedicated. The oracle said that the heart that beats for her would do the wrong thing for the right reason, reach for unspeakable power, and turn dark. Growing up, she became friends withDain Aetosin 619 AU when she was five and he was six as his father,Colonel Aetos, worked as her mother's most trusted aide. Violet and Dain spent most of their time together finding places to swim and climb,which subsequently led Violet to become familiar withNolonand hishealerwife,Winifred, when she was injured. Because of her father's influence, Violet spent her entire life training to become aScribelike him. Following his untimely death, ProfessorMarkhamtook over her studies. Violet was supposed to be his "star pupil"in the Scribe Quadrant before his retirement. In 628 AU, at 14 years old, Violet last saw her brother Brennan prior to theBattle of Aretia, leaving her to mourn him once news spread that he had been killed byFen Riorson, who according to battlefield reports, "put an arrow in his chest."Brennan's death led to their father becoming even more reclusive, and Violet only got to spend time with him because she was also always in the Archives.He died a year or so before the events ofFourth Wingfrom heart failure. In June, 631 AU, Violet began datingPrince Halden Tauri. He was her first love. However, after walking in on him sleeping with one of his professors in December, she left Halden.Sometime within 632July, 633 AU, she dated someone that her father never knew about. The spring before the events ofFourth Wing, her mother told her she would not watch any of her children enter the Scribe Quadrant, and Violet began training withMajor Gillsteadto enter theRiders Quadrantinstead. She passed the admissions test toBasgiath War College, scoring in the top quarter for speed and agility.

Fourth Wing.full_text: The morning ofConscription Day, Violet sees her mother and sister in her mother'soffice. Her sister, Mira, argues with their mother that Violet shouldn't go to the Riders Quadrant because she won't survive, but their mother does not change her mind. Mira then repacks Violet's rucksack for her and gives her rider boots so she has better grip onthe parapet, and a vest made out of dragon scales as armor. Mira warns her to stay away fromXaden Riorson, the son of the Great Betrayer. She meetsRhiannon Matthiasbefore crossing the Parapet and they swap left shoes so that both of them will have one shoe with good grip.She meets Xaden Riorson at the top of the turret, and while crossing, the candidate crossing behind her,Jack Barlowe,attempts to kill her, but she survives. At Basgiath Dain places her in his own squad - Second Squad, Flame Section, Second Wing - but during their first formation Dain's squad is ordered to switch withAura Beinhaven's, moving Violet into Fourth Wing; the wing led by Xaden. Violet is unlike the majority of the volunteers there. She is much smaller than her peers and her fragility causes her to receive harsher injuries than others, while her smaller body and lack of training puts her at a disadvantage during challenges, completingthe Gauntlet, or while riding her dragon. In order to stay alive, she chooses to be one of the cadets who helps prepare and serve breakfast so that she canpoisonher opponents,leading her to win the five challenges beforeThreshing. Violet is full of dread as Xaden forces her to spar against him. He gradually disarms her while also repeatedly offering her insights into how best to use her small stature as an advantage. That night Dain smuggles Violet intohis roomand gives her a leg massage while they discuss how dragons can read the minds of their riders. Dain confesses that he reported Xaden,Jack, and another cadet to Colonel Markham for harassing Violet and wanting to kill her. He again asks her to join the scribes, and Violet lashes out at him. He tries to convince her by describing the horrors of Threshing, but Violet remains resolute. During training forThe Gauntlet, Violet struggles on the final obstacle of the chimney because she is too short. Xaden advises her that "the right way isn't the only way,"and she comes up with a plan - using her dagger in the rock to help fling her the extra distance. WhenAmber Mavisdeclares that this is cheating, Violet quotes the codex.At Presentation before the line of dragons, two greens take an interest in her and Violet realises they can smell her sister's dragonTeine, because her vest is made of Teine's scales. During Threshing, Violet overhears three of her fellow cadets planning to murder a smaller dragon so she rushes to find the small, golden dragon and defends the dragon from them.Xaden witnesses her do so, but according to the rules of the Codex he is unable to interfere and assist her. Violet injures Jack, causing him to flee, and then fights against the other two and knocksOrenunconscious. Tairneanach kills the third,Tynan, when he runs away.Tairn instructs Violet to stop bleeding and to get on his back; he stretches his foreleg out like a ramp for her to be able to do so, something she has never seen a dragon do before. She falls off on their first flight together, but Tairn catches her. "You're making us look bad. Stop it." Tairn to Violet Sorrengail on their first flight together,Fourth Wing Tairn to Violet Sorrengail on their first flight together,Fourth Wing During the events of Threshing, she manages to bond to two dragons: Tairneanach and Andarnaurram. This prompts a meeting ofThe Empyrean, but they allow it. Violet also learns that her dragon Tairn is mated toSgaeyl, Xaden's dragon, meaning that their own lives are now interconnected. After Threshing, she and Dain kiss, only for her to realize that she no longer wants him anymore. Now that shes officially a dragon rider, Violet gets to move into aprivate room. The next morning, she and Rhiannon walk together, and after some light teasing, Violet admits that she felt no spark when Dain kissed her. They meet withRidocand go to breakfast where the other first-year cadets are suddenly treating Violet with kindness. The rest of Second Squad joins them for breakfast, includingImogen, who explains that Tairneanachs presence has caused a significant power shift among cadets. The squad gossips andImogeninforms Violet that she must meet her later for strength training, which Violet realizes means that Xaden is trying to keep her alive. Violet and her squad attend flight training. Tairn arrives, but Andarna stays away because she is too small to carry Violet. While they fly together, Violet andTairnbanter telepathically. Violet insists that Tairn not use his magic to keep her on his back, but she repeatedly falls off, making it necessary for him to dive to catch her.Before first battle of War Games,Xadensurprises her with a custom saddle for Tairn to wear that she can strap herself into. After some time, Violet is attacked while she sleeps by sixunbondedcadets who are hoping to kill her and claim her bond toTairn. Thanks toAndarna'spower, she is able to stop time and get past them,right before Xaden arrives and kills all the assailants.He takes her through a tunnel to speak to their dragons and figure out what just happened. On the way back to the quadrant, Xaden asks Violet how the cadets managed to get into her room when it was locked- she tells him she saw a rider who ran away before he got there;Amber Mavis. After the attack, Xaden has first year cadetLiam Mairitransferred to Violet's squad to protect her. "I do not need a bodyguard." Violet Sorrengail to Xaden Riorson,Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail to Xaden Riorson,Fourth Wing Despite her resentment of the extra protection, Violet soon becomes friends with Liam, who to her annoyance is actually "courteous, funny, and ridiculously helpful." During November on Tuesday nights, Violet's squad practises hand to hand combat in the gym, and one night when she is training she's distracted byXadenandGarrick Tavisfighting each other with their shirts off. She can't keep her eyes off him, thinking to herself that she's got it bad.Jack Barlowetaunts her while she's fightingRhiannon, and Violet stands up for herself without losing her temper, which results in her dragons deciding proudly that she's ready to begin channeling. "You ran. That day in the field, you fucking ran when it was three on one, and we both know when it comes down to it, you'll run again. That's what cowards do." Violet Sorrengail to Jack Barlowe,Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail to Jack Barlowe,Fourth Wing That night Violet begins channeling, and she becomes completely overwhelmed by Tairn's emotions because she hasn't learned how to shield from them yet. She runs intoLiam, but flees before she takes Tairn's feelings out on him. Outside she findsXaden, smoking churam, and she knows it's not just Tairn's feelings influencing her - she's "completely, utterly obsessed with Xaden." He teaches her how to shield, and then they kiss. "You are astonishing. I couldn't do that for weeks." Xaden Riorson to Violet Sorrengail after teaching her how to shield,Fourth Wing Xaden Riorson to Violet Sorrengail after teaching her how to shield,Fourth Wing Xaden breaks off the kiss and tells Violet to go, and she reluctantly goes back inside. The next day she tellsRhiannonall about it, worried that it might make things between her and Xaden weird.Liamgives Violet a little carving of Tairn. Over the next few months Violet trains, practicing shielding and grounding, studying for tests and lifting weights withImogen, but still hasn't manifested her signet power.Jackchallenges Violet to a sparring match, andLiamruns to getXaden.Jackattempts to use his powers against her, but Violet slams a vial of powdered oranges into his mouth, poisoning him. When she wakes up in the infirmary afterwards, Xaden is by her bedside.He tells her that he is taking over her training, since none of the others can be trusted to do a good job because they take it easy on her. February passes by a in a blur of him training her in both sparring, wielding and in flight. Xaden gives her a set of daggers engraved with TyrrishRunesthat are small enough to fit her grip. Violets squad cheers Liam on as he wrestles during theSquad Battle. After he wins, CommandantPanchekannounces that the third stage of the Squad Battle is to take place immediately. He commands the squads to find and acquire the one thing that would be most advantage to their enemies regarding the war effort.They must present their object to leadership within the next three hours. All of the cadets in Leadership have been sequestered, making each squad responsible for their own planning. Imogen takes command of their squad, and they brainstorm what to steal. Liam suggests information, and Violet gets the idea to break into her mothers office. Two hours later, the squad sneaks into General Sorrengails office.Quinnastral-projects to distract the guard, whileNadineunweaves the wards surrounding the office. Violet and the remaining cadets enter the office, with Liam serving as lookout. Violet reads some of her mothers letters which make her realize that they should steal the map on her wall which shows detailed information about outposts and supply routes. Rhiannon manages to teleport the map away while Imogen uses her signet to wipe the recent memories of the guard. Stealing the map leads to Second Squad winning the battle, which means they get to go toMontserratas a reward. Violet is surprised and happy to seeMirawhen they get to Montserrat. When they have been there for a few days, Violet andRhisneak out to visit Rhiannon's family, but are caught byMira. Her sister quickly relents and allows them to go, but accompanies them just in case. While Rhiannon spends time with her family, Violet tells Mira about life in the quadrant. As they are leaving to go back to the outpost, Xaden steps out of the shadows. "My baby sister is a bad-ass." Mira Sorrengail to Violet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Mira Sorrengail to Violet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Violet and half her squad, with the addition of Xaden, spend the next afternoon discussing battle tactics. This is the first time Xaden speaks to Violet in her mind using their bond. The outpost is then attacked by gryphons, and Xaden kisses Violet again to stall for time before the dragons arrive.Violet is terrified something happened toMira, and when Xaden finds her waiting to confront ProfessorMarkhamfor information the next day, he also admits that he cares for her. She figures out how to speak back to him through their bond, and then is relieved to discover Mira is alive.Andarnacomforts her. In May, Violet competes in the first battle of War Games. Xaden surprises her with the saddle he had made for her. Violet at first refuses to use it, saying it won't be allowed, butTairngrowls that he decides what is and isn't allowed, and also says that she has worked just as hard if not harder than any other rider to keep her seat. "You have worked just as hard, if not harder, than every rider in this quadrant. Just because your body is built differently than the others doesn't mean you don't deserve to keep your seat. It takes more than a few strips of leather and a pommel to define a rider." Tairn to Violet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Tairn to Violet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing As their mission for War Games, Violet's squad is tasked with both stealing a crystal egg from First Wing and defending Fourth Wing's flag.Jackattacks Liam, and Violet asksAndarnato use her power stopping time to give Violet a chance of catching him. She does, and then transfers him toRhiannonbefore chasing afterJack.Violet projects all of her power at him in her fury, finally manifesting her signet and calling lightning down from the sky, causing Jack to fall down the mountain beneath an avalanche of rock.Tairnproudly roars "lightning wielder." "I am the sky and the power of every storm that has ever been. I am infinite." Violet Sorrengail, the first time she manifests her signet,Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail, the first time she manifests her signet,Fourth Wing That night Violet is reeling from her first kill, andXadencomes to check on her. He finds her wearing only a nightgown, throwing daggers at the wooden target in her room.They finally give into their attraction for one another and have sex, both of them completely losing control. They break an armoire in their passion, among other things. In the aftermath,Xadenexplains what the 107 scars on his back mean. When Violet wakes in the morning there's a handful of spring violets on her nightstand. Professor Carris waiting outside her door that morning saying that they have work to do to make sure she doesn't burn the quadrant down with her signet. He advises her to make her loyalties clear, as she and Xaden as a team could be viewed as a threat. She practises sending out strikes of lightning but struggles with her aim, and realizes it's going to be harder than she thought. Violet tells Xaden that if he can't give her more than just sex then it's best to leave it as just a one time thing, and they spend the next month fighting the "pulsing need" between them. Violet still can't aim her lightning strikes, but has managed to increase her number of strikes an hour to twenty. On Reunification day - which marks the end of the Battle of Aretia, and therefore six years since her brother was killed - the cadets are required to go to a celebration in dress uniform. Violet opts for a high necked sleeveless top and flowing skirt with a long slit up the thigh.Quinndoes her hair for her, andLiamaccompanies her, saying "I go where you go," and when Violet tells him he's a good friend, he says that she saved his life and it's the least he can do. They sneak out of the party, and Violet goes to find Xaden. Xaden is sitting on the parapet, and he yells at her to turn around when he sees her but she refuses, and tells him she's ready to risk her heart for him. She also admits she was jealous ofImogen, who she thought Xaden had a thing for, but Xaden says, "there's only you, Violence." They go back to his room where Violet tells him that she thinks she's in love with him, and then they have mind blowing sex again. Violet accidentally shatters his window when she loses control, but Xaden protects them with his signet. They're interrupted in the early hours of the morning byGarrick, who informs them that the entire quadrant is being called to formation and that they are under attack. Violet and Xaden scramble to get dressed and join formation. Xaden gives Violet his jacket and when she joins her squad,Rhiannonimmediately identifies it, grinning at her and saying "I knew it!" She stands in front of Violet whenDainarrives so that he doesn't notice the wingleader patch. As Leadership confers, Xaden telepathically informs Violet that it is not actually an attack but rather the last event of War Games.Colonel Aetosgives orders to each wingleader. Xaden is ordered to select riders to be stationed with him outside the borders of Navarres wards atAthebyne, where they will remain for five days. Everyone quickly packs and prepares for the long flight.Liamis unusually tense. Violet seesAndarnaand grows concerned about her ability to keep up and hide during the fights to come. Then she sees a harness she is wearing that can hook toTairn's saddle, allowing him to carry her easily. Xaden approaches and claimsLiam,Imogenand Violet for his team despite Dains resistance. Dain and Xaden argue and Violet intervenes, which makes Dain realize that something is going on between the two of them. He begs Violet not to go, saying "he's going to get you killed," but Violet insists that she trusts Xaden, and goes with him. They fly toAthebyneand stop to take a break at a lake closest to the outpost so that the dragons can rest and have a drink.Xadenand Violet are behind a rock together, kissing, when they are surprised by a pair of gryphon riders. Violet immediately moves to attack them, but Xaden stops her, and she is horrified when he says to them, "you're fucking early," revealing that he knows them. The gryphon riders (as Violet calls them, not knowing yet that they are called fliers) tell them, to Violet's confusion, that they have been patrolling nearby and thatVeninrecently decimated a nearby town. When they leave after delivering their warning, Violet realizes that she is the only one there who didn't know that Xaden has been aiding the enemy and also that she is the only one who doesn't have a rebellion mark. She accuses Xaden of being a traitor, but when he explains about theVeninand that they are actually real, Violet comes to understand that it might be true. However she is furious that he never told her the truth, and Xaden tells her that he couldn't - because ifDainused his signet on her he would know everything. Before flying toAthebyne, she tells him she believes him, but doesn't trust him any more. When they get toAthebynethey find the Outpost deserted and a missive waiting for them. The letter says that it is a test of their command - which Xaden says is really a test of their loyalty; they must choose between leaving the outpost and pretending they have seen nothing, or defendingResson, the trading post just across the border. All of the riders, including Violet, vote to defend Ressoneven if it means they might die. "I've been defenseless, and now I'm a rider. Riders fight." Violet Sorrengail to Xaden Riorson before the battle at Resson,Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail to Xaden Riorson before the battle at Resson,Fourth Wing During theBattle of Resson, Violet does her best to hit the venin with lightning. She tries to provide cover for the riders evacuating the townspeople on the ground, and does her best to focus on her own job rather than on worrying aboutXaden. She seesSoleil Telerydie, stepping into the dead zone of earth drained by the venin, and warns the others. She tells Xaden they need to lure the venin away from the city, and then continues to try striking them with lightning over and over again, but she doesn't have enough control. Liam and his dragonDeighcome to Violet and Tairn's aid when they are attacked by aWyvern, which leads toDeigh's death - and thereforeLiam's. There is nothing Violet can do to help him, and Xaden carries Liam over to his dragon so that they can die together. Heartbroken, Violet goes back into the battle, determined to be "as strategic asBrennan, as confident asMira," and to show the assholes exactly how violent she can be. A venin appears on the back ofTairn, and Violet unbuckles herself in order to fight it. She is stabbed in the side by the venin, but uses her power to blind it temporarily, and then kills it. She realizes that killing a venin also destroys anyWyvernthat they might have created, and determinedly goes after the last venin, managing to aim true and strike it with lightning. Then she falls from Tairn's back, hearing Xaden scream her name as she does. Andarna catches her mid-fall, stopping time for long enough for the others to pull Violet to safety from her back. Violet fades in and out of consciousness as waves of pain like fire consume her. Xaden snaps to someone that her blood is "fuckingblack," andImogencries that it has to be poison. The cadets argue over her about where to take her, but soon agree that they will save her. Violet isn't sure how much time passes, but is flown somewhere, Xaden holding her all the while and telling her that she needs to fight. Violet wakes up three days later toXadenwaiting for her by her bedside. At first she doesn't seem to remember what happened, allowing Xaden to check her wounds, and looking at him in confusion when he promises to make it all up to her. Then her eyes widen, and she asks him where they are - saying "don't you dare lie to me. Not again." She recognizesAretiafrom the temple outside the window, and Xaden thinks to himself that she is brilliant. After a shower, Xaden returns to his room where she is waiting and begs her for forgiveness. Before they can really talk about anything, there's a knock on the door - and they are interrupted by Brennan. Violet stares at her older brother in shock as he welcomes her to theRevolution.
paragraphs: The morning ofConscription Day, Violet sees her mother and sister in her mother'soffice.
Her sister, Mira, argues with their mother that Violet shouldn't go to the Riders Quadrant because she won't survive, but their mother does not change her mind.
Mira then repacks Violet's rucksack for her and gives her rider boots so she has better grip onthe parapet, and a vest made out of dragon scales as armor.
Mira warns her to stay away fromXaden Riorson, the son of the Great Betrayer.

She meetsRhiannon Matthiasbefore crossing the Parapet and they swap left shoes so that both of them will have one shoe with good grip.She meets Xaden Riorson at the top of the turret, and while crossing, the candidate crossing behind her,Jack Barlowe,attempts to kill her, but she survives.

At Basgiath Dain places her in his own squad - Second Squad, Flame Section, Second Wing - but during their first formation Dain's squad is ordered to switch withAura Beinhaven's, moving Violet into Fourth Wing; the wing led by Xaden.
Violet is unlike the majority of the volunteers there.

She is much smaller than her peers and her fragility causes her to receive harsher injuries than others, while her smaller body and lack of training puts her at a disadvantage during challenges, completingthe Gauntlet, or while riding her dragon.
In order to stay alive, she chooses to be one of the cadets who helps prepare and serve breakfast so that she canpoisonher opponents,leading her to win the five challenges beforeThreshing.
Violet is full of dread as Xaden forces her to spar against him.
He gradually disarms her while also repeatedly offering her insights into how best to use her small stature as an advantage.
That night Dain smuggles Violet intohis roomand gives her a leg massage while they discuss how dragons can read the minds of their riders.
Dain confesses that he reported Xaden,Jack, and another cadet to Colonel Markham for harassing Violet and wanting to kill her.
He again asks her to join the scribes, and Violet lashes out at him.
He tries to convince her by describing the horrors of Threshing, but Violet remains resolute.
During training forThe Gauntlet, Violet struggles on the final obstacle of the chimney because she is too short.
Xaden advises her that "the right way isn't the only way,"and she comes up with a plan - using her dagger in the rock to help fling her the extra distance.

WhenAmber Mavisdeclares that this is cheating, Violet quotes the codex.At Presentation before the line of dragons, two greens take an interest in her and Violet realises they can smell her sister's dragonTeine, because her vest is made of Teine's scales.

During Threshing, Violet overhears three of her fellow cadets planning to murder a smaller dragon so she rushes to find the small, golden dragon and defends the dragon from them.Xaden witnesses her do so, but according to the rules of the Codex he is unable to interfere and assist her.
Violet injures Jack, causing him to flee, and then fights against the other two and knocksOrenunconscious.

Tairneanach kills the third,Tynan, when he runs away.Tairn instructs Violet to stop bleeding and to get on his back; he stretches his foreleg out like a ramp for her to be able to do so, something she has never seen a dragon do before.
She falls off on their first flight together, but Tairn catches her.
"You're making us look bad.

Stop it." Tairn to Violet Sorrengail on their first flight together,Fourth Wing Tairn to Violet Sorrengail on their first flight together,Fourth Wing During the events of Threshing, she manages to bond to two dragons: Tairneanach and Andarnaurram.
This prompts a meeting ofThe Empyrean, but they allow it.
Violet also learns that her dragon Tairn is mated toSgaeyl, Xaden's dragon, meaning that their own lives are now interconnected.
After Threshing, she and Dain kiss, only for her to realize that she no longer wants him anymore.
Now that shes officially a dragon rider, Violet gets to move into aprivate room.
The next morning, she and Rhiannon walk together, and after some light teasing, Violet admits that she felt no spark when Dain kissed her.
They meet withRidocand go to breakfast where the other first-year cadets are suddenly treating Violet with kindness.
The rest of Second Squad joins them for breakfast, includingImogen, who explains that Tairneanachs presence has caused a significant power shift among cadets.
The squad gossips andImogeninforms Violet that she must meet her later for strength training, which Violet realizes means that Xaden is trying to keep her alive.
Violet and her squad attend flight training.
Tairn arrives, but Andarna stays away because she is too small to carry Violet.
While they fly together, Violet andTairnbanter telepathically.

Violet insists that Tairn not use his magic to keep her on his back, but she repeatedly falls off, making it necessary for him to dive to catch her.Before first battle of War Games,Xadensurprises her with a custom saddle for Tairn to wear that she can strap herself into.
After some time, Violet is attacked while she sleeps by sixunbondedcadets who are hoping to kill her and claim her bond toTairn.

Thanks toAndarna'spower, she is able to stop time and get past them,right before Xaden arrives and kills all the assailants.He takes her through a tunnel to speak to their dragons and figure out what just happened.
On the way back to the quadrant, Xaden asks Violet how the cadets managed to get into her room when it was locked- she tells him she saw a rider who ran away before he got there;Amber Mavis.
After the attack, Xaden has first year cadetLiam Mairitransferred to Violet's squad to protect her.

"I do not need a bodyguard." Violet Sorrengail to Xaden Riorson,Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail to Xaden Riorson,Fourth Wing Despite her resentment of the extra protection, Violet soon becomes friends with Liam, who to her annoyance is actually "courteous, funny, and ridiculously helpful." During November on Tuesday nights, Violet's squad practises hand to hand combat in the gym, and one night when she is training she's distracted byXadenandGarrick Tavisfighting each other with their shirts off.

She can't keep her eyes off him, thinking to herself that she's got it bad.Jack Barlowetaunts her while she's fightingRhiannon, and Violet stands up for herself without losing her temper, which results in her dragons deciding proudly that she's ready to begin channeling.
"You ran.
That day in the field, you fucking ran when it was three on one, and we both know when it comes down to it, you'll run again.

That's what cowards do." Violet Sorrengail to Jack Barlowe,Fourth Wing Violet Sorrengail to Jack Barlowe,Fourth Wing That night Violet begins channeling, and she becomes completely overwhelmed by Tairn's emotions because she hasn't learned how to shield from them yet.
She runs intoLiam, but flees before she takes Tairn's feelings out on him.

Outside she findsXaden, smoking churam, and she knows it's not just Tairn's feelings influencing her - she's "completely, utterly obsessed with Xaden." He teaches her how to shield, and then they kiss.
"You are astonishing.

I couldn't do that for weeks." Xaden Riorson to Violet Sorrengail after teaching her how to shield,Fourth Wing Xaden Riorson to Violet Sorrengail after teaching her how to shield,Fourth Wing Xaden breaks off the kiss and tells Violet to go, and she reluctantly goes back inside.
The next day she tellsRhiannonall about it, worried that it might make things between her and Xaden weird.Liamgives Violet a little carving of Tairn.

Over the next few months Violet trains, practicing shielding and grounding, studying for tests and lifting weights withImogen, but still hasn't manifested her signet power.Jackchallenges Violet to a sparring match, andLiamruns to getXaden.Jackattempts to use his powers against her, but Violet slams a vial of powdered oranges into his mouth, poisoning him.

When she wakes up in the infirmary afterwards, Xaden is by her bedside.He tells her that he is taking over her training, since none of the others can be trusted to do a good job because they take it easy on her.
February passes by a in a blur of him training her in both sparring, wielding and in flight.
Xaden gives her a set of daggers engraved with TyrrishRunesthat are small enough to fit her grip.
Violets squad cheers Liam on as he wrestles during theSquad Battle.
After he wins, CommandantPanchekannounces that the third stage of the Squad Battle is to take place immediately.

He commands the squads to find and acquire the one thing that would be most advantage to their enemies regarding the war effort.They must present their object to leadership within the next three hours.
All of the cadets in Leadership have been sequestered, making each squad responsible for their own planning.
Imogen takes command of their squad, and they brainstorm what to steal.
Liam suggests information, and Violet gets the idea to break into her mothers office.
Two hours later, the squad sneaks into General Sorrengails office.Quinnastral-projects to distract the guard, whileNadineunweaves the wards surrounding the office.
Violet and the remaining cadets enter the office, with Liam serving as lookout.
Violet reads some of her mothers letters which make her realize that they should steal the map on her wall which shows detailed information about outposts and supply routes.
Rhiannon manages to teleport the map away while Imogen uses her signet to wipe the recent memories of the guard.
Stealing the map leads to Second Squad winning the battle, which means they get to go toMontserratas a reward.
Violet is surprised and happy to seeMirawhen they get to Montserrat.
When they have been there for a few days, Violet andRhisneak out to visit Rhiannon's family, but are caught byMira.
Her sister quickly relents and allows them to go, but accompanies them just in case.
While Rhiannon spends time with her family, Violet tells Mira about life in the quadrant.
As they are leaving to go back to the outpost, Xaden steps out of the shadows.

"My baby sister is a bad-ass." Mira Sorrengail to Violet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Mira Sorrengail to Violet Sorrengail,Fourth Wing Violet and half her squad, with the addition of Xaden, spend the next afternoon discussing battle tactics.
This is the first time Xaden speaks to Violet in her mind using their bond.

The outpost is then attacked by gryphons, and Xaden kisses Violet again to stall for time before the dragons arrive.Violet is terrified something happened toMira, and when Xaden finds her waiting to confront ProfessorMarkhamfor information the next day, he also admits that he cares for her.
She figures out how to speak back to him through their bond, and then is relieved to discover Mira is alive.Andarnacomforts her.
In May, Violet competes in the first battle of War Games.
Xaden surprises her with the saddle he had made for her.

Violet at first refuses to use it, saying it won't be allowed, butTairngrowls that he decides what is and isn't allowed, and also says that she has worked just as hard if not harder than any other rider to keep her seat.
"You have worked just as hard, if not harder, than every rider in this quadrant.
Just because your body is built differently than the others doesn't mean you don't deserve to keep your seat.

It takes more than a few strips of leather and a pommel to define a rider." She does, and then transfers him toRhiannonbefore chasing afterJack.Violet projects all of her power at him in her fury, finally manifesting her signet and calling lightning down from the sky, causing Jack to fall down the mountain beneath an avalanche of rock.Tairnproudly roars "lightning wielder." "I am the sky and the power of every storm that has ever been.

He finds her wearing only a nightgown, throwing daggers at the wooden target in her room.They finally give into their attraction for one another and have sex, both of them completely losing control.
They break an armoire in their passion, among other things.
In the aftermath,Xadenexplains what the 107 scars on his back mean.
When Violet wakes in the morning there's a handful of spring violets on her nightstand.
Professor Carris waiting outside her door that morning saying that they have work to do to make sure she doesn't burn the quadrant down with her signet.
He advises her to make her loyalties clear, as she and Xaden as a team could be viewed as a threat.
She practises sending out strikes of lightning but struggles with her aim, and realizes it's going to be harder than she thought.
Violet tells Xaden that if he can't give her more than just sex then it's best to leave it as just a one time thing, and they spend the next month fighting the "pulsing need" between them.

Iron Flame.full_text: Violet, now anwoken from her coma, finds herself in the fortress atAretia.She has been mended by her brother,Brennan, who she is still surprised to find alive. When Violet tests her bonds she finds relief thatTairnis still there, and so isAndarna, however her bond with andarna seems different and less golden, but she attributes this to still being groggy and Andarna still sleeping after all the energy she expended at the battle in Resson. Brennan leaves Violet to finish eating breakfast while he meets with theAssemblyof the Revolution, promising to bring Violet to see her dragons once he is done. Violet decides to follow after him and gawks at the impressive architecture and art of the fortress one her way to find him. Violet findsImogenandBhodistanding outside the meeting and join them to listen as theAssemblydiscuss if the cadets should return toBasgiathor not. The assembly also discusses the need to trade withViscount Tecarisfor aluminary,but a deal has not yet been reached. The assembly is worried they have only a year before they lose the war withvenin, and Violet is surprised to find out they are so close to losing a war she knew nothing about. EventuallyXadeninforms the assembly that they do not get to decide if the cadets return or not, they may only advice, though the assembly argues hard the Violet should not be allowed to leave because they do not believe she will keep the revolution secret. Violet stands up for herself stating all that she has done to prove her bravery, and loyalty. Brennan adjourns the meeting, and Xaden tells Violet to join them in the Valley when she's done speaking to Brennan. Voilet's conversation withBrennanbegins with her questioning if he has been inAretiaall these years. Brennan expresses how glad she is that Voilet has made it this far, and they discuss howMirahelped her survive. When Violet asks Brennan how he survived, Brennan reveals thatNaolin(Tairn's previous rider) didn't fail, but it cost him everything. Violet and Brennan also disucss theVeninissue and Brennan says he thinks theAssemblyis wrong and that there is six months or less before the Venin are strong enough to come forNavarre. Voilet asks Brennan if he thinks their dad,Asher, Knew and he says he chooses to believe he didn't. This conversation also reveals thatAretiapossesses a dormant ward stone, but they do not know how to activate it. Violet thinks the answer may lie in theArchives, but Brennan warns her that the Archives should be considered enemy territory, and she shouldnt investigate.Brennanbelieves their best shot is getting theLuminarywho can intensify dragon fire in order to create more of the alloy that can destroyVenin. Voilet accuses Brennan of thinking he can win againstNavarrebecause he calls the movement a revolution instead of a rebelion. Voilet asks for more details butBrennansays he can't tell her until she learns to shield fromDain. Brennan finally takes Violet to meet up with Xaden and the other cadets, where she finally seesAndarna,who is now twice the size she was two days ago and her scales have started to turn black and somewhat iridescent. The usage of her time stopping ability in Resson was too much and the effort forced accelerated growth, which forced her into adolescence. Violet tells the group that she thinks they have to go back to Basgiath because if they don't they will execute all the remaining cadets with rebellion relics. Brennan argues that Violet is likely to be executed if she goes back, but Violet is sure she can convince her mother, and she won't allow anyone to execute her. Some of the other cadets agree with her, stating theDainwas loud about his fatherColonel Aetosplanning the games. The group votes and everyone except Brennan and Xaden raise their hands to go back. Xaden states that he will train Voilet to strengthen her shields, and decided that once Andarna wakes up they will fly for Basgiath. Violet flies with her group back toBasgiath. WhenAndarnawakes up Violet is concerned because she is struggling to stretch her wings and even walk, butTairnis sure he can help by carrying her in her harness if needed. Once thereXaden, Violet, and the others interrupt formation where they find their names being called on the death roll. After she convinces her mother that the marked ones are not traitors and that they were left to battle the enemy at an abandoned outpost,General SorrengailadmonishesColonel Aetosfor what she says is an disastrous and dangerous mistake in his planning of the war games, and relieves him of his position atBasgiath, moving him elsewhere. Violet then graduates from her first year. She spends the next five days preparing for second-year. Xaden and Violet are still struggling with the balance between trust and keeping secrets when Xaden, now graduated and a Lieutenant, receives his orders to leave. Violet and Xaden assume they will see each other often because ofTairnandSgaeyl, butVarrishgive them orders that they may only have leave once every fortnight. As Violet settles in to her new second year routine she struggles with watching the new first years die, only learningSloane MairiandAaric Greycastles names to avoid and more heartbreak and trauma than necessary. Voilet continues to struggle when she is faced with assassins targeting her, and the other marked ones that went to Resson. In addition, leadership does whatever they cane to separate Violet and Xaden even further, like signing Xaden up for duties Voilet doesnt have clearance to join on, or taking Violet and her support out into the middle of the woods to practice survival skills for her new rider survival course. During this time Violet also seeks outJesiniato help her find books in the hopes of finding information on how to create new wards, though she is apprehensive about getting her friend involved in what is essentially treason.
paragraphs: Violet, now anwoken from her coma, finds herself in the fortress atAretia.She has been mended by her brother,Brennan, who she is still surprised to find alive.

When Violet tests her bonds she finds relief thatTairnis still there, and so isAndarna, however her bond with andarna seems different and less golden, but she attributes this to still being groggy and Andarna still sleeping after all the energy she expended at the battle in Resson.
Brennan leaves Violet to finish eating breakfast while he meets with theAssemblyof the Revolution, promising to bring Violet to see her dragons once he is done.
Violet decides to follow after him and gawks at the impressive architecture and art of the fortress one her way to find him.
Violet findsImogenandBhodistanding outside the meeting and join them to listen as theAssemblydiscuss if the cadets should return toBasgiathor not.
The assembly also discusses the need to trade withViscount Tecarisfor aluminary,but a deal has not yet been reached.
The assembly is worried they have only a year before they lose the war withvenin, and Violet is surprised to find out they are so close to losing a war she knew nothing about.

EventuallyXadeninforms the assembly that they do not get to decide if the cadets return or not, they may only advice, though the assembly argues hard the Violet should not be allowed to leave because they do not believe she will keep the revolution secret.
Violet stands up for herself stating all that she has done to prove her bravery, and loyalty.
Brennan adjourns the meeting, and Xaden tells Violet to join them in the Valley when she's done speaking to Brennan.
Voilet's conversation withBrennanbegins with her questioning if he has been inAretiaall these years.
Brennan expresses how glad she is that Voilet has made it this far, and they discuss howMirahelped her survive.
When Violet asks Brennan how he survived, Brennan reveals thatNaolin(Tairn's previous rider) didn't fail, but it cost him everything.
Violet and Brennan also disucss theVeninissue and Brennan says he thinks theAssemblyis wrong and that there is six months or less before the Venin are strong enough to come forNavarre.
Voilet asks Brennan if he thinks their dad,Asher, Knew and he says he chooses to believe he didn't.
This conversation also reveals thatAretiapossesses a dormant ward stone, but they do not know how to activate it.

Violet thinks the answer may lie in theArchives, but Brennan warns her that the Archives should be considered enemy territory, and she shouldnt investigate.Brennanbelieves their best shot is getting theLuminarywho can intensify dragon fire in order to create more of the alloy that can destroyVenin.
Voilet accuses Brennan of thinking he can win againstNavarrebecause he calls the movement a revolution instead of a rebelion.
Voilet asks for more details butBrennansays he can't tell her until she learns to shield fromDain.

Brennan finally takes Violet to meet up with Xaden and the other cadets, where she finally seesAndarna,who is now twice the size she was two days ago and her scales have started to turn black and somewhat iridescent.
The usage of her time stopping ability in Resson was too much and the effort forced accelerated growth, which forced her into adolescence.
Violet tells the group that she thinks they have to go back to Basgiath because if they don't they will execute all the remaining cadets with rebellion relics.
Brennan argues that Violet is likely to be executed if she goes back, but Violet is sure she can convince her mother, and she won't allow anyone to execute her.
Some of the other cadets agree with her, stating theDainwas loud about his fatherColonel Aetosplanning the games.
The group votes and everyone except Brennan and Xaden raise their hands to go back.
Xaden states that he will train Voilet to strengthen her shields, and decided that once Andarna wakes up they will fly for Basgiath.
Violet flies with her group back toBasgiath.
WhenAndarnawakes up Violet is concerned because she is struggling to stretch her wings and even walk, butTairnis sure he can help by carrying her in her harness if needed.
Once thereXaden, Violet, and the others interrupt formation where they find their names being called on the death roll.

After she convinces her mother that the marked ones are not traitors and that they were left to battle the enemy at an abandoned outpost,General SorrengailadmonishesColonel Aetosfor what she says is an disastrous and dangerous mistake in his planning of the war games, and relieves him of his position atBasgiath, moving him elsewhere.
Violet then graduates from her first year.
She spends the next five days preparing for second-year.
Xaden and Violet are still struggling with the balance between trust and keeping secrets when Xaden, now graduated and a Lieutenant, receives his orders to leave.
Violet and Xaden assume they will see each other often because ofTairnandSgaeyl, butVarrishgive them orders that they may only have leave once every fortnight.

As Violet settles in to her new second year routine she struggles with watching the new first years die, only learningSloane MairiandAaric Greycastles names to avoid and more heartbreak and trauma than necessary.
Voilet continues to struggle when she is faced with assassins targeting her, and the other marked ones that went to Resson.

In addition, leadership does whatever they cane to separate Violet and Xaden even further, like signing Xaden up for duties Voilet doesnt have clearance to join on, or taking Violet and her support out into the middle of the woods to practice survival skills for her new rider survival course.

During this time Violet also seeks outJesiniato help her find books in the hopes of finding information on how to create new wards, though she is apprehensive about getting her friend involved in what is essentially treason.

Body.full_text: Violet is self-described as too small and too fragile. Her exact height and weight are not given, but she is shorter than 5'4" based on Xaden's comments (shes assumed to be 52" or 53"). At the start of theseriesshe weighs no more than 115 pounds. Due to a connective tissue disorder, she bruises, dislocates joints, and breaks bones easily. According to Mira, Violet had already broken her arm prior to the events ofFourth Wingand sprains some joint every other week.She uses cloth wraps with metal clasps given to her by Major Gilstead to wrap her joints and prevent them from dislocating or being further injured.Prior to any sparring match, Violet makes sure to wrap her joints to prevent them from dislocating or tearing. Violet Sorrengail byLeah Croft She is mentioned by her mother to have "pale skin, pale eyes and pale hair" due to a sickness her mother caught during pregnancy. According to Violet she has two shades; pale and burned.Her hair is brown and starts to slowly fade around her shoulders to a steely, metallic silver by the ends. The natural pigment seems to gradually abandon it no matter the length so cutting it short wouldn't remove the metallic ends. To stay agile in sparring and in battle, she keeps her hair braided in a crown around her head so it can't be grabbed easily. Violet's eyes are a light hazel of varying blues and ambers. She wears size 7 boots, and carries a sheathed dagger in her right boot as well as three other daggers sheathed on her ribs across Parapet.She has adragon relicon her back of a black dragon mid-flight that stretches from shoulder to shoulder with a silhouette of a golden, shimmering dragon in the center.

Time Manipulation.full_text: Also known as Andarna's Feathertail Gift. Due to her bond with Andarna, Violet was briefly able to stop the flow of time. However, since Andarna is a feathertail the magic channeled through her is slightly different than that of a fully-grown dragon, and so Andarna could die if Violet channeled too much through her. Violet's extended use of Andarna's gift during Resson caused the dragon to be unable to fully form her wing during the dreamless sleep and is therefore directly responsible for Andarna's inability to carry a rider. They both lost the ability to manipulate time once Andarna entered the dreamless sleep.

Before going to Basgiath, Violet is warned to stay away from Xaden because he will kill her since Violet's mother is the one that killed Xaden's father. She was attracted to Xaden from the first time that she saw him on the parapet but even though she was worried that he would kill her, she continued to challenge him. She slowly gained respect for him when she learned that he was trying to help the first-year marked kids survive in the Riders Quadrant and agreed to keep that secret. As their relationship progressed she began to compare him with her childhood best friend, Dain, which only served to fuel her interest in Xaden. Her life became attached to his when she bonded with Tairneanach, who ismatedto Xaden's dragon,Sgaeyl, thus keeping Violet alive became Xaden's top priority. They first kissed when they were influenced by their mated dragons' strong emotions. Eventually they stopped denying their feelings for each other and they had sex a couple times. However, by the end of the events ofFourth Wing, Violet felt betrayed by Xaden because of several secrets, which she discovered he had been keeping from her.

Before crossing the parapet, Violet traded one of her rubber-bottomed shoes with Rhiannon, so Rhiannon could have a better chance of surviving the crossing. Since that day, they were best friends through the first year, as well as squadmates. Rhiannon helps train Violet in sparring, while Violet helped Riannon in history. However, Violet did keep a few secrets from her friend, such as Xaden meeting with others marked with the rebellion relic, or Andara's sharing her gift to stop time. Their relationship became more tense during their second year, when Violet had to keep even more secrets from her friend. Rhiannon could clearly see that both Violet was keeping secrets and that it was causing emotional stress. Even if it makes me a target to know all of this, you put your own life at risk and shared your boot with me at Parapet when we were complete strangers. Sloane Mairi.full_text: Despite Sloane's initial visible hatred for Violet, Violet decides to honor Liam's dying wish in protecting his younger sister any way that she can. During Conscription Day, Violet convinces Dain to call a favor in and transfer Sloane into their Fourth Wing Squad so that she can continue to keep an eye on her. Two weeks later Violet helps Sloane win her first sparring challenge by drugging her opponent,Dasha Fabrren, and then blackmails Sloane into accepting Imogen's help by promising to give Sloane one of Liam's 50 letters he wrote to her for each week she trained.

Catriona Cordella.full_text: Catriona does not like Violet because Violet is in the way of her goal, while Violet is jealous about her previous relationship with Xaden. With every comment towards Violet, she aims to discredit her relationship with Xaden. She was aware of Violet before Violet was aware of her, and uses this to get under Violet's skin. This almost succeeds, with Violet having to make a noticeable effort to control her signet power, so she does not kill her. During her challenge with Violet, she constantly taunts her about her previous relationship with Xaden, referring specifically to the times where they had sexual relations. When Violet gains the upper hand and begins to choke her out, she would rather die than tap out. They are forced to work together after Catriona's drift is assigned to Violet's squad to make the climb through the Medaro Pass. She blames Violet for failing to save one of her friends,Luella, who failed to make the jump across. She vows to kill Violet for this. Although both despise each other, they have a moment of truce each day during morning formation, when the names of those who died are read out. They understand each other's worry for their siblings, who are fighting on the frontlines. After they fight together against the venin, they continue to develop respect and less antagonism towards each other.

Trivia.full_text: Violet gets injured easily and often suffers from bruises and dislocated joints because she has Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, though it is not named in the series. Rebeccapictured Dove Cameron and Florence Pugh while writing Violet. The first time Violet states her full name on the parapet, thunder cracks above her and she finds that oddly comforting. Her favorite target when throwing daggers is the shoulder. At the end ofFourth WingViolet has 24 daggers. She brought 4 across the Parapet with her, earned 19, and had 1 left over from the battle against the venin. Violet was ranked amongst the top 25 for speed and agility during her entrance exam for Basgiath War College. The second person Violet dated is a character that does not appear in the first three books of the series.

Biography.full_text: The former Viscount is the distant cousin of the Poromish queen,Queen Maraya, and was named her heir. At the time, he was over 50 years old and had no direct heirs of his own, so his appointment was not well-loved decision. He was the Viscount of the Poromish province of Krovla until the death ofQueen Maraya, when he ascended to the throne of Poromiel. He lives inCordyn. The former Viscount was the first ally thatFen Riorsonsought out at the start of his rebellion.Xaden Riorsonended their alliance during the events ofFourth Wing. Prior to the events ofIron Flame, Xaden was betrothed to his niece,Catriona Cordella, which started a year earlier, when Catriona turned 20. He broke off the betrothal when he realized that Tecarus would never actually give the luminary to the revolution, and was only going to allow the revolution to use it in Cordyn. During the events of Iron Flame, Viscount Tecarus was in possession of a luminary, which is a device that completes a forge, that the Revolution needed in order to make their own weapons. The Viscount was willing to give the forge to the Revolution in exchange for weapons, a private army, and the opportunity to seeVioletwield lightning, Xaden refused his offer because he was unwilling to allow Violet to show him her wielding. After having that offer refused, in exchange for entering negotiations for the luminary, he wants to see Violet wield. Violet Sorrengail, Xaden Riorson,Mira Sorrengail, andBrennan Sorrengail, under the name Lieutenant Colonel Aisereigh, travel to Cordyn to negotiate for the luminary. Before they can begin negotiations, Tecarus confirms that Violet is, in fact, capable of wielding lightning by having her striker the Rybestad chest, the chest that Fen Riorson brought for his negations during the rebellion; it was one Fen Riorson's most valuable items that he owned. Before Violet is able to strike the chest with her lightning, A Venin emerges from the chest, looking like they had been kept prison for weeks. Together, Brennan, Mira, and Violet were able to kill the Venin. After that, Tecarus reveals that he quarried stones from the east of the Dunness River, the land that borders the Barrens that had already been drained of its magic, because he has been capturing Venin. Tecarus agrees to give the revolution the luminary if they took and trained the hundred flier cadets that took shelter with him afterCliffsbane Flight Academywas destroyed by venin, and supply the gryphon drifts with weapons. During the events ofOnyx Storm, Tecarus repeatedly reminds Violet through letters delivered by emissaries that she must keep her end of the bargain by safeguarding and training the hundred flier cadets that were sent to Basgiath along with the luminary.Violet had also asked for unrestricted access to Tecarus's library in the hopes of finding information that could cure venin. Once the Second Aretia Accord has been signed, then-Viscount Tecarus helps facilitate a meeting between Violet and her "quest squad" andKing CourtlynofDeverelli. Not wantingPrince Haldento arrive at the meeting being carried in a basket by agryphon, Tecarus sends Halden to Deverelli in one of his fastest ships.The meeting quickly turns violent as a result of Halden's deceptive actions and attempted theft, though King Courtlyn singles out Tecarus to spare from the chaos. After Suniva falls to dark wielders and Queen Maraya is killed, Tecarus becomes King of Poromiel.Still, he keeps up his end of his deal with Violet and continues to send her books about venin.

Personality.full_text: The Viscount enjoys collecting precious things, whether they be items or people, for his collection. While he does not hold people against their will, he has the gift of being able to see what motivates them to give up their treasures. Palace.full_text: His home, inCordyn, is a palace on the eastern side of a mountain peak when approached from the direction of Aretia. It is a sprawling structure with a glistening combination of white pillars and blue pools that cascade in five distinct terraces down the gentle slope of the hills above the beach. The interior is build with white marble and is much more of a palace than a fortress. It is indefensible and would fall if venin chose to take it. The ceilings are the height ofSgaeyl, and the main entrance is a large open-concept room with columns as thick asTairneanach's legs. Intricate murals are carved into each circular block with a spiral staircase that leads to the second story. The pool is turquoise and winds around the staircase and out onto the terrace. They do not have rails around them.
